title: Convergence of Roberts flow dynamos in Eulerian and Lagrangian codes
comment: 31 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to J. Plasma Phys
summary: Standard benchmark tests for numerical magnetohydrodynamics codes focus on one- and two-dimensional problems that ignore the possibility of dynamos, i.e., an exponential instability converting kinetic energy into magnetic energy. They also tend to ignore magnetic helicity conservation that can have dramatic effects in periodic domains. The existence of magnetic diffusion is crucial for dynamos, as was exemplified by the impossi- bility of finding dynamo solutions when using Euler potentials, which is a perfectly valid approach in the absence of magnetic diffusion. The Roberts flows I, II, III, and IV are two- dimensional flows that support three-dimensional dynamos, all of which are also large- scale dynamos in the sense that their planar averages are of significant strengths, even though flow II is pointwise non-helical. Here we demonstrate the numerical convergence properties of solutions obtained using discretisation schemes of second, sixth, and tenth order in the mesh width in the Pencil Code, compare the results with the SPH- based SWIFT code, and present a list of averaged quantities that facilitate their use in characterising the solutions as benchmarks. In addition, we present a procedure to obtain two-dimensional time-independent magnetic field visualisation for all Roberts flows, and perform per-pixel comparison between the Pencil and SWIFT codes. The rich combination of features makes Roberts flows an excellent dynamo benchmark for the direct numerical simulations of magnetohydrodynamics equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Roberts流(I–IV)作为磁流体力学数值代码的三维发电机基准测试,并比较Pencil与SWIFT代码的数值收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有MHD标准基准多限于一、二维问题,忽略了发电机效应(动能转磁能的指数不稳定性)及磁螺度守恒的重要性;磁扩散对发电机至关重要。Roberts流虽为二维流却能支持三维发电机,是理想的基准候选。
AI.method: 使用Pencil Code中二阶、六阶和十阶离散格式求解Roberts流解,考察数值收敛性;与基于SPH的SWIFT代码对比;对全部Roberts流给出二维定常磁场可视化方法,并进行Pencil与SWIFT的逐像素比较。
AI.result: 展示了不同离散阶数的收敛特性,给出与SWIFT代码的对比结果及逐像素比较,并提供一组平均量以刻画这些基准解。
AI.conclusion: Roberts流兼具多样特性,是MHD直接数值模拟的优秀发电机基准。

title: Reliable Uncertainty Estimation for Machine-Learned Multigroup Cross Sections Without Retraining
summary: Uncertainty quantification in machine learning models is essential for nuclear energy applications. While machine learning models can make both uncertainty and point predictions, these models are often significantly more difficult to train jointly than models that make point predictions alone. Split conformal prediction is a family of methods for computing distribution-free prediction intervals by calculating nonconformity scores corresponding to a target quantile in a calibration dataset. Although conformal prediction only guarantees marginal coverage, normalizing nonconformity scores enables predictive interval widths to be calculated on a per-sample basis, providing an approximation to conditional coverage. In this work, we connect uncertainty predicting neural networks to pre-trained networks that estimate shielding factors in multigroup neutron cross sections. We train the uncertainty models on the same OpenMC data used by the pre-trained models, whose weights and biases remain fixed. The outputs of the uncertainty models are the standard deviations of the residual, separated into contributions from the model and tally uncertainty. Their corresponding variances are combined in quadrature to provide a normalizing factor for conformal prediction, providing interval widths that are adaptive on a per-sample basis. Baselines for comparison are established using Mondrian conformal prediction, and by using the ground truth OpenMC uncertainties as normalizers in the conformal framework. We use predicted uncertainty interval widths and the severity of predictions that overshoot the interval widths as bases for comparing our normalizer with the baselines. We find that our method dramatically reduces both interval widths and the degree to which predictions fall outside these widths.

AI.tldr: 将预训练shield算因子网络与不确定性预测网络连接，用模型与计数不确定性的方差合成作为归一化因子，实现逐样本自适应的分裂共形预测区间。
AI.motivation: 核能应用中机器学习模型的不确定性量化至关重要，但联合训练点预测与不确定性模型远比单独训练点预测模型困难，因此需要一种更易训练且能提供近似条件覆盖的分布无关预测区间方法。
AI.method: 基于预训练的多群中子截面shield算因子网络（权重冻结），在相同OpenMC数据上训练不确定性模型，输出残差标准差并分解为模型不确定性与tally计数不确定性，二者方差按平方和合成，作为共形预测的归一化因子，得到逐样本自适应区间宽度；以Mondrian共形预测和真实OpenMC不确定性作为归一化基准进行对比。
AI.result: 与Mondrian共形预测及真实OpenMC不确定性归一化基准相比，该方法显著减小了预测区间宽度，同时降低了预测超出区间宽度的程度。
AI.conclusion: 将不确定性预测网络与预训练点预测网络解耦连接，并用方差合成归一化共形分数，可在核能中子截面shield算因子任务上有效提升预测区间的紧致性与条件覆盖近似质量。

title: Self-Shielded Multigroup Microscopic Cross Section Generation Using Targeted Artificial Neural Networks
summary: Multigroup neutron transport models are used widely in simulation codes due to their memory and compute efficiency compared to continuous energy methods. However, multigroup codes rely on nuclear data prepared using approximate methods that require significant manual effort and expertise to account for self-shielding effects. In addition, multigroup nuclear data libraries prepared in this way can be limited in their applicability for modeling diverse reactors and operating conditions. Here we show that trained artificial neural networks can predict self-shielded microscopic cross sections accurately in pincell simulations containing uranium dioxide fuel with a fixed geometry and temperature. The model's predictive accuracy remains high across fuel enrichment and burnup ranges encountered in light water reactors. Critically, the neural networks' predictions require only the atomic concentration of the fuel's constituent nuclides as inputs. The networks are trained using 8,704 samples of training and validation data generated using continuous energy OpenMC pincell simulations. The trained neural networks predict self-shielded total, fission, absorption, elastic, and total scattering cross sections for combinations of 90 nuclides in the CASMO-8 energy group structure. The neural networks' predictions of self-shielded cross sections are validated by comparison with 1,500 samples of reference cross sections unseen during training and tallied using OpenMC simulations. The predicted and ground truth cross sections in the test data set agree to within 0.119% on average. When the predicted cross sections are used in a multigroup eigenvalue run, they achieve a mean absolute error in keff of 200 pcm.

AI.tldr: 训练人工神经网络可从燃料核素原子浓度直接预测自屏微观截面，测试集平均误差0.119%，用于多群keff计算误差200 pcm。
AI.motivation: 多群中子输运模型因内存和计算效率高被广泛使用，但依赖近似方法制备的核数据，自屏效应处理需大量人工与专业知识，且库的适用性受反应堆类型和工况限制。
AI.method: 用连续能量OpenMC pin-cell模拟生成8,704个训练与验证样本，训练神经网络，仅以燃料中各核素原子浓度为输入，在CASMO-8能群结构下预测90种核素组合的自屏总截面、裂变、吸收、弹性及总散射截面。
AI.result: 在未参与训练的1,500个参考样本上验证，预测截面与真值平均一致到0.119%以内；将预测截面用于多群本征值计算，keff平均绝对误差为200 pcm。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络可准确预测固定几何与温度下二氧化铀pin-cell的自屏截面，并在轻水堆富集度与燃耗范围内保持高精度，为减少多群核数据制备的人工依赖提供可行途径。

title: Heat Transport of the $β$-Fermi--Pasta--Ulam--Tsingou chain in the long-wave limit
summary: Resolving the anomalous conductivity exponent of the symmetric $β$-Fermi--Pasta--Ulam--Tsingou chain by molecular dynamics can require very large systems because of long finite-size crossovers and thermal-contact resistance. Motivated by this computational challenge, we derive a long-wavelength continuum description and investigate whether the kinetic-theory scaling $κ\propto L^{2/5}$ becomes accessible with a moderate number of numerical degrees of freedom. The nonlinear elastic field retains the cubic stress of the microscopic interaction and exchanges heat with Langevin reservoirs. A flux-conservative spatial discretization constructs the force and energy current from the same stress, providing a consistent interior transport estimator. For $L>8$, corresponding to approximately $10^3$ mesh nodes and above at the reference resolution, the fitted exponent is $0.399\pm0.004$. Mesh refinement supports the stability of this exponent between the two finer resolutions, although the conductivity amplitude remains resolution-dependent. The main result is thus an accessible finite-size regime near $2/5$, rather than convergence of the absolute conductivity as the mesh spacing vanishes. This formulation provides a practical route to studying anomalous transport in anharmonic systems and a conservative continuum framework for investigating energy flow in nonlinear elastic media.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过长波长连续场描述与分子动力学模拟，研究对称β-FPU链的异常导热指数，发现约在10^3网格节点下即可获得接近2/5的标度指数。
AI.motivation: 直接分子动力学求解该指数的异常导热需要极大系统规模，受限于有限尺寸交叉和热接触电阻，因此寻求更高效的计算路径。
AI.method: 推导长波长连续场描述，保留微观相互作用的三次应力项，并与Langevin热浴耦合；采用通量守恒空间离散，从同一应力构造力与能流，提供一致的内域输运估计。
AI.result: 当L>8（约10^3网格节点及以上）时，拟合指数为0.399±0.004；网格加密验证指数在两种更细分辨率间稳定，但导热幅值仍依赖分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是揭示一个可计算的有限尺寸区间接近2/5，而非网格趋于零时绝对导热的收敛，为研究非谐系统异常输运提供了实用且守恒的连续框架。

title: Remote magnon sensing detects the universal phase stiffness jump in Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$
summary: Phase stiffness governs macroscopic quantum coherence in superfluids and superconductors, providing a sensitive probe of condensate depletion, fluctuations, and phase transitions. However quantitative and spatially resolved measurements remain challenging. Here we report a contactless, local, all-optical measurement of superconducting phase stiffness using propagating antiferromagnetic magnons as remote sensors. In CrSBr, strong exciton-magnon coupling enables optical excitation and detection of magnon wavepackets and precise determination of their group velocity. When CrSBr is interfaced with underdoped Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$, we find that the magnon group velocity is substantially enhanced below the superconducting transition and quantitatively encodes the phase stiffness through Meissner screening currents. Using this capability, we identify a parallel-field-induced Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition through direct observation of the universal phase-stiffness jump, revealing a field-controlled route to expose intrinsic two-dimensional phase-ordering physics in a bulk cuprate. Our work establishes propagating magnons as local probes of superconducting electrodynamics and phase-coherent phenomena in low-dimensional quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 利用CrSBr中的传播反铁磁磁振子作为远程传感器，实现超导相位刚度的无接触、局域、全光学测量。
AI.motivation: 相位刚度决定超流/超导的宏观量子相干性，是探测凝聚体耗尽、涨落和相变的敏感探针，但定量且空间分辨的测量仍具挑战。
AI.method: 在CrSBr中通过强激子-磁振子耦合光学激发/探测磁振子波包并测其群速度；将其与欠掺杂Bi2212界面结合，磁振子群速度在超导转变温度以下被显著增强，并通过Meissner屏蔽电流定量编码相位刚度。
AI.result: 观测到平行场诱导的Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless相变，直接观察到普适的相位刚度跃变，揭示块体铜氧化物中本征二维相位有序物理的场控途径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了传播磁振子作为低维量子材料中超导电动力学和相位相干现象的局域探针。

title: Zero Mode Operators and Charge-Conjugation Defects in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall-Superconductor Heterostructures
summary: We study zero modes bound to charge-conjugation defects in fractional quantum Hall-superconductor (FQH-SC) heterostructures built from Abelian and non-Abelian FQH states. Although the associated defects are well described by $G$-crossed braided tensor categories, a local operator description of their zero modes is not generally known. We generalize the bulk-to-boundary construction of localized zero mode operators to FQH-SCs with non-Abelian parent topological orders, mapping bulk Wilson operators in the folded theory to localized zero mode operators in the one-dimensional FQH-SC theory. This construction distinguishes zero mode anyons from the local zero mode operators that act on the defect Hilbert space and yields a generalized zero mode algebra. It also determines the fusion-channel dependence of tunneling: tunneling of zero mode operators probes bulk monodromy, while direct zero mode anyon transfer probes $G$-crossed associativity data. Applying this framework, we recover the $\mathbb{Z}_{2m}$ parafermion zero mode structure of fermionic Laughlin FQH-SCs at filling $ν=1/m$, obtain a $\mathbb{Z}_2^{(n)}\times\mathbb{Z}_N$ structure for generalized Moore-Read states at filling $ν=1/m$, with $N=2m$ for fermionic states and $N=m$ for bosonic states, and find a $\mathrm{Fib}\times\mathbb{Z}_N$ structure for the $k=3$ Read-Rezayi state at filling $ν=3/(3M+2)$, with $N=2(3M+2)$ for fermionic states and $N=(3M+2)/2$ for bosonic states. In the Read-Rezayi case, zero mode operator tunneling and direct zero mode anyon transfer yield distinct universal amplitude ratios between the neutral fusion channels, providing a characteristic signature of the underlying Fibonacci defect structure.

AI.tldr: 研究FQH-SC异质结中电荷共轭缺陷的零模，推广bulk-to-boundary构造到非阿贝尔母拓扑序，得到广义零模代数及隧穿融合通道依赖，并应用于Laughlin、Moore-Read和Read-Rezayi态。
AI.motivation: FQH-SC异质结中束缚于电荷共轭缺陷的零模虽可用G-crossed辫张量范畴描述，但缺乏一般性的局域算符描述，需要建立bulk Wilson算符与一维局域零模算符的对应。
AI.method: 将bulk-to-boundary局域零模算符构造推广至非阿贝尔FQH-SC，把折叠理论中的bulk Wilson算符映射为一维FQH-SC理论中的局域零模算符，区分零模任意子与作用在缺陷Hilbert空间的局域零模算符。
AI.result: 恢复fermionic Laughlin ν=1/m的Z_{2m} parafermion结构；广义Moore-Read态得到Z_2^{(n)}×Z_N结构（fermionic N=2m，bosonic N=m）；k=3 Read-Rezayi态ν=3/(3M+2)得到Fib×Z_N结构（fermionic N=2(3M+2)，bosonic N=(3M+2)/2）。
AI.conclusion: 该构造给出广义零模代数，揭示隧穿融合通道依赖；在Read-Rezayi情形零模算符隧穿与直接零模任意子转移给出不同的普适振幅比，成为Fibonacci缺陷结构的特征信号。

title: Thermal Diffusivity in Metallic Nanowire Aerogels
summary: Metallic nanowire aerogels combine the functional properties of metals with the high porosity of aerogels. Here, Ag and Cu nanowire aerogels with densities of 20-500 mg cm-3 were synthesized by freeze casting and investigated using lock-in thermography during sequential mechanical compaction. Thermal transport depended strongly on nanowire diameter, with 30 nm Ag nanowires exhibiting substantially lower thermal diffusivity than 60 nm wires, likely due to enhanced surface scattering as the wire diameter approaches the electron mean free path in Ag. Surprisingly, increasing the aerogel density through mechanical compaction reduced the calculated thermal diffusivity by nearly 300x, opposite the conventional expectation that denser materials transport heat more efficiently. Further analysis showed that this decrease is dominated by the thickness term in the thermal diffusivity formalism, while the fitted transport coefficient changes comparatively little. The characteristic thermal diffusion timescale decreased only modestly during compaction, indicating that densification primarily collapses pore volume without fundamentally restructuring the conductive nanowire network. This behavior resembles topology-preserving densification, where large geometric compression produces comparatively small changes in the effective percolative transport pathway. These results show that nanowire aerogels cannot always be treated as homogeneous bulk media, because their macroscopic geometry and conductive network evolve differently during compaction.

AI.tldr: 通过冷冻铸造制备Ag和Cu纳米线气凝胶，用锁相热成像研究压缩过程中的热输运，发现致密化反而大幅降低计算热扩散率，源于厚度项主导而非导电网络重构。
AI.motivation: 金属纳米线气凝胶兼具金属功能性与气凝胶高孔隙率，但其热输运在机械压缩下如何演变尚不清楚，且气凝胶能否当作均质体处理存疑。
AI.method: 冷冻铸造合成密度20-500 mg cm-3的Ag和Cu纳米线气凝胶；在连续机械压缩过程中用锁相热成像（lock-in thermography）测量热输运，考察纳米线直径（30 nm vs 60 nm）影响，并分解热扩散率公式中的厚度项与输运系数。
AI.result: 热输运强烈依赖纳米线直径，30 nm Ag线因表面散射增强（接近电子平均自由程）热扩散率明显低于60 nm线；压缩增密使计算热扩散率降低近300倍，与传统预期相反，主要由厚度项贡献，拟合输运系数变化不大；特征热扩散时间尺度仅温和下降。
AI.conclusion: 致密化主要塌缩孔隙体积而非重构导电纳米线网络，表现为拓扑保持型致密化；纳米线气凝胶不能总被当作均质体，其宏观几何与导电网络在压缩中演化不同。

title: Superconducting edge contact to a buried Ge quantum well
summary: Semiconductor-superconductor hybrid systems form the basis for a broad range of quantum phenomena, such as Andreev bound states, topological superconductivity, and hybrid quantum Hall states. The performance of these hybrid systems can strongly benefit from the exceptional electronic properties of heterostructures with deeply buried quantum wells. However, establishing high-quality superconducting contacts to such quantum wells remains challenging. Here, we address this problem with an edge-contact approach that combines anisotropic dry etching to access the quantum well followed by wet etching for interface preparation. Josephson junctions fabricated using this approach consistently exhibit near-unity interface transparency, while quantum point contacts show strong Andreev enhancement, with the first conductance plateau approaching $4e^2/h$, the limit of perfect Andreev reflection. In superconducting quantum point contacts, the high contact quality is further manifested by quantized supercurrent. These results establish the combination of dry and wet etching as a robust strategy for integrating deeply buried quantum wells into superconducting hybrid devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种干法刻蚀与湿法刻蚀结合的边缘接触方法，为深埋量子阱建立高质量超导接触，实现近乎完美的安德烈夫反射与量子化超电流。
AI.motivation: 半导体-超导体混合系统是众多量子现象（安德烈夫束缚态、拓扑超导、混合量子霍尔态等）的基础，而深埋量子阱异质结构具有优异电子特性，但难以向其建立高质量超导接触，这是亟需解决的难题。
AI.method: 采用边缘接触方案：先用各向异性干法刻蚀暴露量子阱，再用湿法刻蚀进行界面制备。
AI.result: 该方法制备的约瑟夫森结界面透明度接近1；量子点接触表现出强安德烈夫增强，首个电导平台接近4e²/h（完美安德烈夫反射极限）；超导量子点接触中观察到量子化超电流，进一步证明接触质量高。
AI.conclusion: 干湿刻蚀结合是一种将深埋量子阱集成到超导混合器件中的稳健策略。

title: Phase diagram of a semiflexible magnetic polymer in three dimensions
summary: We study a semiflexible magnetic polymer in which each monomer carries a two-state spin, giving rise to coupled conformational, stiffness, and magnetic degrees of freedom. The model provides a minimal representation of nucleoprotein complexes in vivo, in which DNA bending rigidity and bridging proteins must be simultaneously accommodated. We employ Monte Carlo simulations on a face-centered-cubic (FCC) lattice, complemented by a variational free-energy upper-bound approach, to characterize the zero-field phase diagram as a function of bending stiffness and temperature. At low stiffness, we identify a first-order transition combining coil-to-globule collapse with a ferromagnetic-to-paramagnetic transition. At lower temperatures, an additional first-order transition separates the disordered globule from an ordered crystal characterized by nematic-like orientational order of the bond tangents. At high stiffness, the globule disappears, resulting in a direct first-order coil-to-crystal transition. These results demonstrate how chain stiffness and magnetic degrees of freedom couple to polymer conformation and reorganize the zero-field phase diagram. Our model connects the two limiting cases of flexible magnetic polymers and semiflexible homopolymers, the latter corresponding to the strong-field limit in which all spins are aligned.

AI.tldr: 半柔性磁性聚合物中，每个单体带二态自旋，耦合构象、刚度与磁自由度，模拟其零场相图。
AI.motivation: 为在体内核蛋白复合物中同时容纳DNA弯曲刚度和桥连蛋白提供最小模型，连接柔性磁性聚合物与半柔性均聚物两个极限。
AI.method: 在面心立方晶格上进行蒙特卡洛模拟，并结合变分自由能上界方法。
AI.result: 低刚度下发现一阶跃迁，结合线圈-球状坍缩与铁磁-顺磁转变；更低温度下另一一阶跃迁将无序球状与键切向呈类向列取向有序的晶体分开；高刚度下球状消失，出现直接的一阶线圈-晶体转变。
AI.conclusion: 链刚度和磁自由度耦合影响聚合物构象并重组零场相图，模型统一了柔性磁性聚合物与半柔性均聚物（强场极限）两种情形。

title: Angular Momentum Fluctuations Induced by Phonon-Rotation Coupling Govern Nuclear Spin Relaxation in a Molecular Rotator Phase
summary: Nuclear spin relaxation has been widely used to probe molecular reorientation in solids, yet its interpretation has always required assuming both the relaxation mechanism and the form of the underlying correlation function. In rotator-phase solids more unknowns enter the picture: in ammonium iodide, the proton T$_1$ passes through a maximum and decreases with temperature, a behavior attributed to spin-rotation coupling. Here we model both the dipolar and the spin-rotation contributions to $^1$H relaxation in solid NH$_4$I from first principles, by combining molecular dynamics with machine-learned force fields trained on density functionals and ab initio spin-rotation coupling tensors. The computed rates reproduce the measured values above the order-disorder transition, together with their temperature dependence and frequency independence, and show that fluctuations of the NH$_4^+$ angular momentum dominate relaxation throughout the rotator phase. The orientational and angular-velocity correlation functions obtained directly from the simulations further share an oscillatory component at lattice-phonon frequencies, revealing a coupling between lattice vibrations and cation reorientation that contributes measurably to relaxation. Separating this component yields a reorientational barrier in agreement with neutron scattering. The approach makes nuclear spin relaxation a quantitative benchmark for simulated dynamics in molecular solids and provides direct access to angular-momentum correlations in the solid state.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理结合分子动力学与机器学习力场，从头计算固体NH4I中质子的偶极与自旋-转动弛豫贡献，定量重现实验值并揭示角动量涨落主导弛豫。
AI.motivation: 核自旋弛豫长期被用于探测固体分子重取向，但其解释往往需要预设弛豫机制与关联函数形式；在转子相固体中未知量更多，例如NH4I中质子T1出现极大值并随温度下降，一般认为源于自旋-转动耦合，但缺乏从第一性原理出发的定量验证。
AI.method: 结合分子动力学与基于密度泛函训练的机器学习力场，并计算从头自旋-转动耦合张量，对NH4I中^1H弛豫的偶极贡献和自旋-转动贡献进行第一性原理建模；直接从模拟获得取向与角速度关联函数并分离晶格声子振荡成分。
AI.result: 计算的弛豫速率在有序-无序转变温度以上与实验值吻合，并重现其温度依赖与频率无关性；表明NH4+角动量涨落在整个转子相主导弛豫。取向与角速度关联函数含晶格声子频率的振荡成分，揭示晶格振动与阳离子重取向耦合对弛豫有可测贡献；分离该成分后得到的重取向势垒与中子散射一致。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使核自旋弛豫成为分子固体中模拟动力学的定量基准，并可直接获取固态中的角动量关联。

title: Electronic Properties of Ladder-Type Phenylenes Studied by Thermally-Assisted-Occupation Density Functional Theory
summary: Accurate prediction of the electronic properties of extended $π$-conjugated systems with radical character remains a major theoretical challenge. To overcome this challenge, thermally-assisted-occupation density functional theory (TAO-DFT) has been developed in recent years. In this study, we employ TAO-DFT to systematically explore the electronic properties of ladder-type phenylenes ($n$-LPs), containing $n$ fused four-membered carbon rings. Our calculations reveal that all investigated $n$-LPs (with $n$ = 1 ~ 40) possess singlet ground states. With increasing $n$-LP size, we observe a transition from the nonradical character of smaller $n$-LPs to the polyradical character of larger $n$-LPs. Notably, we identify a distinct damped periodic oscillation in the radical character of $n$-LPs, featuring highly correlated hotspots at specific intervals ($n = 3k - 1$, where $k$ are positive integers). The real-space representation of active orbitals confirms this global electronic behavior is governed by the structural localization of active orbitals along the central ladder framework. These findings provide fundamental insights into the size-dependent electronic properties of $n$-LPs, guiding their rational design for future nanomaterial applications.

AI.tldr: 采用TAO-DFT系统研究梯形苯撑(n-LP)电子性质，发现其基态均为单重态，随尺寸增大从非自由基转变为多自由基，并呈现阻尼周期振荡（热区位于n=3k-1）。
AI.motivation: 扩展π共轭自由基体系的电子性质精确预测是重大理论挑战，需借助TAO-DFT加以解决。
AI.method: 使用热辅助占据密度泛函理论(TAO-DFT)，系统计算含n个稠合四元碳环的梯形苯撑(n=1~40)的电子性质，并分析活性轨道的实空间分布。
AI.result: 所有n-LP均为单重态基态；随尺寸增大由非自由基特征转变为多自由基特征；自由基特征呈阻尼周期振荡，在n=3k-1处出现高度相关热区；活性轨道沿中央梯形骨架局域化，决定整体电子行为。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了n-LP尺寸依赖的电子性质规律，为其在纳米材料中的理性设计提供基础指导。

title: Superconducting Diode Effect due to the Inverse Spin Hall Effect in Josephson Junctions with Extrinsic Spin-Orbit Interaction
summary: The spin density and Josephson current at equilibrium are studied numerically in a superconductor-normal metal-superconductor (SNS) junction with extrinsic spin-orbit interaction in the N segment. This system preserves structural inversion symmetry. We find that the Josephson current generates the spin Hall effect, resulting in an opposite spin density near the two edges of the N segment. We also find that a Zeeman magnetic field with gradient applied to the N segment generates an anomalous phase shift due to the inverse spin Hall effect, resulting in a diode effect when higher harmonics of the Josephson current are present. These results are consistent with those of a previous theoretical study based on diagrammatic perturbation theory. We find that the diode effect becomes more pronounced when stronger coupling between the N and S segments enhances the higher harmonics.

AI.tldr: 本文数值研究了含外禀自旋轨道相互作用的SNS结中平衡自旋密度与约瑟夫森电流，揭示了约瑟夫森电流产生自旋霍尔效应及梯度磁场引起的二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 探究在保持结构反演对称的SNS结中，外禀自旋轨道相互作用如何影响平衡自旋密度与约瑟夫森电流，以及其与自旋霍尔/逆自旋霍尔效应及二极管效应的关联。
AI.method: 对N区含外禀自旋轨道相互作用的SNS结进行数值计算，分析平衡态下的自旋密度与约瑟夫森电流，并考察N区施加梯度塞曼磁场的情形。
AI.result: 约瑟夫森电流产生自旋霍尔效应，使N段两边缘附近出现相反的自旋密度；梯度塞曼磁场通过逆自旋霍尔效应产生反常相移，当存在高次谐波时出现二极管效应；N-S耦合增强使高次谐波增强，二极管效应更显著。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果与基于图解微扰论的既有理论研究一致，并表明增强的N-S耦合可放大高次谐波从而强化二极管效应。

title: Exact solutions for kinematics across interaction-deformed Fermi surfaces
summary: Luttinger's theorem fixes the volume of the Fermi sea of a Fermi liquid, but not how interactions redistribute occupation around its surface. For an interaction switched on and tuned at fixed density, we derive the exact rates of change of the occupation deficit inside the interacting Fermi surface and of the surplus outside it. Each is the weight swept by the deforming surface plus a change of Luttinger's integrand at fixed momentum; the difference of the surface terms is flux of incoherent weight $1 - Z_{\vec k}$. These identities hold with or without the Luttinger theorem.

AI.tldr: 严格推导相互作用开关、固定密度调节时费米面内外占据缺陷/盈余的变化率，分解为形变扫过的权重与固定动量下Luttinger被积函数的变化，其差为不相干权重1−Z的通量，且不依赖Luttinger定理成立与否。
AI.motivation: Luttinger定理只固定费米液体费米海体积，不说明相互作用如何重新分布费米面附近的占据。作者希望刻画相互作用在固定密度下打开/调节时，费米面内占据缺陷与面外盈余的精确变化规律。
AI.method: 在固定密度下绝热开关相互作用，追踪相互作用费米面形变与被积函数变化。将占据变化分解为：形变表面扫过的权重项 + 固定动量下Luttinger被积函数的变化项；并比较各表面项之差。
AI.result: 得到占据缺陷与盈余变化率的精确恒等式；差值为不相干权重1−Z_k的通量（准粒子相干因子相关的表面贡献）。这些恒等式在Luttinger定理成立或不成立时都有效。
AI.conclusion: 相互作用对费米面附近占据的重新分布可被精确分解为几何表面形变项与Luttinger被积函数变化项，且与Luttinger定理相互独立，提供了超越该定理的占据重分布刻画。

title: Probing magnetic interactions in real space via magnetic pair distribution function analysis
summary: Determining magnetic exchange interactions is vital for understanding the magnetic behavior of materials. The standard method for exchange interaction determination involves performing inelastic neutron scattering experiments on single crystals to measure spin wave dispersions from a long-range-ordered magnetic ground state. However, the influence of exchange interactions is not limited exclusively to spin waves in ordered states, but also governs magnetic behavior in all magnetic states, including the short-range spin correlations that persist into the paramagnetic regime. Exchange parameters have been successfully recovered in the past from energy-integrated diffuse neutron scattering data from paramagnets, indicating that the diffuse scattering and underlying short-range magnetic correlations are rich in information. Consequently, magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) analysis, which directly probes short-range magnetic correlations in real space, is expected to be well suited for extracting exchange parameters from correlated paramagnets. Here, we demonstrate a robust mean-field theory approach incorporating the Onsager reaction field for determination of exchange parameters from the results of mPDF analysis. We successfully apply this approach to several relevant materials to recover exchange interaction values comparable to literature values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合Onsager反应场的平均场方法，从mPDF分析结果中提取磁交换相互作用参数，并在多种材料上验证其与文献值相符。
AI.motivation: 确定磁交换相互作用对理解材料磁行为至关重要。传统方法需对单晶进行非弹性中子散射以测量自旋波色散，但要求长程有序磁基态，限制较大。交换作用同样影响顺磁区的短程自旋关联，因此从顺磁体的漫散射数据中亦可提取交换参数，而mPDF分析直接探测实空间短程磁关联，有望用于顺磁体交换参数提取。
AI.method: 提出一种稳健的平均场理论方法，引入Onsager反应场，用于从mPDF分析结果中确定交换参数。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于多种相关材料，成功恢复了与文献值相当的交换相互作用值。
AI.conclusion: 基于Onsager反应场的平均场配合mPDF分析，可有效从关联顺磁体中提取磁交换参数，为传统单晶非弹性中子散射方法提供了可行替代。

title: Valley transitions during spin shuttling in Si/SiGe heterostructures
summary: Valley excitations are considered one of the biggest challenges for a coherent spin shuttling in Si/SiGe heterostructures. In this work we theoretically investigate the valley dynamics during spin shuttling in a Si/SiGe heterostructure by considering a two-level system given by the two low-lying valley states of the mobile quantum dot. We assume that the electron is initially in the valley ground state and analyze the evolution of this state during shuttling. We find that, depending on the shuttling velocity, the system can be in three distinct regimes. In one of these regimes, the quantum information is preserved even in the presence of the valley excitations, allowing for coherent spin shuttling independently of the shuttling distance. This regime is obtained for a shuttling velocity of tens of m/s, a desired regime where dephasing mechanisms, such as spin-valley hotspots and spatially varying spin splitting, can be suppressed. This result is in accordance with recent experimental work that obtained a high spin shuttling fidelity after a fast and long shuttling. We also propose strategies based on the Partial Landau-Zener model to enhance the valley shuttling fidelity, which was found to be much more efficient than previously proposed strategies based on the standard Landau-Zener model.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究 Si/SiGe 异质结中自旋shuttling过程中的谷动力学，发现在特定shuttling速度下系统处于可保持量子信息的区间，实现与距离无关的相干自旋shuttling。
AI.motivation: 谷激发被认为是Si/SiGe异质结中相干自旋shuttling的最大挑战之一，需要理解并克服谷动力学对量子信息的影响。
AI.method: 将移动量子点的两个低能谷态视为二能级系统，假设电子初态处于谷基态，分析其在shuttling过程中的演化，并基于Partial Landau-Zener模型提出提升谷shuttling保真度的策略。
AI.result: 发现依shuttling速度不同存在三个不同区间；其中在数十m/s速度的区间，即使存在谷激发也能保持量子信息，实现与shuttling距离无关的相干自旋shuttling，并可抑制退相干机制（如自旋-谷热点和空间变化的自旋劈裂），与近期实验高保真度结果一致。
AI.conclusion: Partial Landau-Zener模型提出的策略比以往基于标准Landau-Zener模型的策略更有效，可用于增强谷shuttling保真度。

title: Coupled Cluster Amplitude Extrapolation in Geometry Optimization
comment: Main article 17 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Supplementary material 6 pages, 7 figues, 1 table
summary: In this work, we present an amplitude extrapolation ansatz for geometry optimization that uses calculations from previous steps to construct an initial guess for the quasi-Newton solver at each new geometry, significantly accelerating convergence of the coupled-cluster and Lambda solver alike. The ansatz incorporates a necessary amplitude transformation to mitigate discontinuities associated with orbital energy crossings at the Hartree-Fock level of theory, while remaining computational and memory efficient. The method is tested for a diverse set of medium-sized molecules to demonstrate a systematic and significant reduction in the number of coupled-cluster iterations compared to the conventional method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种振幅外推方法用于几何优化，利用前一步计算结果为每步新几何的准牛顿求解器构造初始猜测，加速耦合簇及Lambda求解器收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统耦合簇几何优化中，每个新几何都需要从头求解振幅，收敛慢，迭代次数多。
AI.method: 振幅外推ansatz，用前几步计算结果构造初始猜测；引入必要的振幅变换以消除Hartree-Fock轨道能级交叉引起的不连续性，同时保持计算与内存高效。
AI.result: 在多种中等大小分子上测试，相比传统方法，耦合簇迭代次数系统性且显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效加速几何优化中的耦合簇与Lambda求解器收敛，且计算与内存开销低，适用于中等规模分子。

title: Origins of Universal Machine Learning Force-Field Errors in Multicomponent Materials
summary: Universal machine learning force-field generalization to multicomponent environments generated by compositional design remains insufficiently assessed. We construct a benchmark of 7,599 multicomponent configurations inspired by high-entropy design, elemental substitution and anion mixing. Eleven pretrained models are evaluated against density functional theory for energies, forces and stresses, with assessment extended to elastic, vibrational and adsorption-related properties. Force errors are analysed through training-reference coverage, local geometric heterogeneity, distance directionality and elemental response. Distances to training-reference environments reveal a qualitative association between coverage differences and increasing errors, while substantial variation remains at similar distances. Higher-error groups show greater local geometric heterogeneity, although OMat24 provides broad coverage of these environments. Relative to training-reference pair medians, errors remain low near the median, rise steeply on the compression side and increase more weakly on the extension side. After matching element pairs and absolute distance deviations, compression-side force errors are 1.81-1.95 times extension-side errors. Model-predicted pairwise interaction curves show greater curvature under compression. Fitting difficulty in independent elemental systems correlates with electronic band-energy responses to atomic displacements and Fermi-level shifts, and a similar pattern is observed in multicomponent systems. In parameter-matched comparisons, spherical-harmonic representations with maximum degrees of 2 and 4 lower test force errors for 38 and 40 of 43 elements, respectively, while differences in elemental difficulty remain. These findings inform force-field selection for experimental compositional design and identify targets for training-data sampling and model representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了7599个多组分构型基准，评估11个预训练机器学习力场对DFT的泛化能力，揭示覆盖度、几何异质性、距离方向性及元素响应等对力误差的影响规律。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习力场对由组分设计生成的多组分环境的泛化能力尚缺乏充分评估，需系统基准来指导模型选择与训练数据采样。
AI.method: 构建受高熵设计、元素替换和阴离子混合启发的7599个多组分构型基准；以DFT为参照评估11个预训练模型在能量、力、应力及弹性、振动、吸附性质上的表现；从训练参考覆盖度、局部几何异质性、距离方向性和元素响应四个角度分析力误差。
AI.result: 训练参考环境距离与误差增大呈定性关联，但相同距离下误差差异仍大；高误差组局部几何异质性更强；相对参考对中位数，压缩侧误差陡升、拉伸侧较弱，匹配后压缩侧误差为拉伸侧1.81-1.95倍；模型预测相互作用曲线在压缩下曲率更大；元素拟合难度与能带能量响应及费米能级移动相关；最大度为2和4的球谐表示分别在43种元素中的38和40种上降低测试力误差。
AI.conclusion: 研究为实验组分设计中的力场选择提供依据，并指出训练数据采样与模型表示优化的方向。

title: Delamination in Large REBCO Coils
summary: REBCO coated conductors have been used in ultrahigh field magnets for condensed matter physics research, nuclear fusion, particle accelerators, and NMR applications. It is well known, however, that they are not mechanically strong against delamination due to their intrinsic layered structures. As a result, the delamination issue has become one of the major design challenges of REBCO magnet coils. As a part of the development of the 40 T all-superconducting magnet at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory, USA, large-scale coils wound by two-in-hand REBCO conductor with turn-to-turn insulation was designed and tested at 4.2 K in an 11.4 T background magnetic field. We found REBCO degradations within the windings and at the crossover joints during the tests. The postmortem inspection found that the degradation was caused by delamination. The delamination appears on the surface of the conductor as bubbles which were subsequently studied by microscopy. Additionally, a similar bubble was found on a short sample by torque magnetometry. This supports the inference that the delamination bubbles found in coils are due to electromagnetic stress. In this paper, we present these findings. The implication of these findings for future magnet designs and the method of mitigation will be discussed.

AI.tldr: REBCO涂层导体因层状结构易分层，在40T全超导磁体线圈测试中导致绕组及交叉接头退化，研究通过显微与磁转矩分析确认分层气泡由电磁应力引起。
AI.motivation: REBCO涂层导体广泛应用于超高场磁体，但其层状结构使其抗分层能力弱，分层问题成为磁体线圈设计的主要挑战之一，因此需研究其失效机制。
AI.method: 在国家强磁场实验室40T全超导磁体研发中，设计并测试了双股REBCO导体绕制、带匝间绝缘的大型线圈，在4.2K、11.4T背景磁场下进行测试，并对分层气泡进行显微镜观察和短样品磁转矩测量。
AI.result: 测试中发现绕组内部及交叉接头处REBCO性能退化，尸检确认由分层引起；导体表面出现气泡，显微分析及短样品磁转矩测量均观察到类似气泡。
AI.conclusion: 线圈中的分层气泡源于电磁应力，这一发现对未来磁体设计具有重要启示，论文还将讨论缓解方法。

title: From continuum neural quantum states to effective lattice models: Fluctuating Wigner molecules in moiré superlattices
summary: Effective descriptions of quantum materials rely on a separation of energy scales that identifies their low-energy degrees of freedom. When kinetic energy, lattice potential, and interactions compete, this hierarchy breaks down, and both the microscopic state and its effective description are unknown. Continuum neural quantum states (NQS) can find the ground state directly without projecting onto prescribed bands, orbitals, or spins, but their microscopic wavefunctions are difficult to interpret in terms of effective variables. Here, we introduce a wavefunction readout that maps the continuum NQS onto site-resolved charge and spin statistics, allowing effective degrees of freedom to emerge from the microscopic solution. Focusing on moiré transition metal dichalcogenides at filling $ν= 3$, the NQS reveals a low-spin ground state below the ferromagnetic crystal of spin-polarized Wigner molecules. Although the charge density retains triangular molecular motifs, our readout reveals significant charge fluctuations through bound nearest-neighbor doublon--hole pairs. Each molecular charge state has an inert spin-singlet core and rim electrons that carry the spin. Charge and spin fluctuations are therefore intertwined, with antiferromagnetic spin-correlations between sites, motivating an effective description by a spinful two-orbital Hubbard model. More generally, our results demonstrate a route from continuum wavefunctions to effective lattice models when competing scales preclude a controlled reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种波函数读出方法，将连续神经量子态映射为位点分辨的电荷与自旋统计，使有效自由度从微观解中涌现。在ν=3莫尔TMD中揭示低自旋基态及电荷-自旋纠缠涨落，并推导出有效双轨道Hubbard模型。
AI.motivation: 量子材料的有效描述依赖能量尺度分离以识别低能自由度，但当动能、晶格势与相互作用竞争时该层级失效，微观态及其有效描述均未知。连续NQS虽能直接求解基态而不需预设能带或轨道，但其微观波函数难以用有效变量解释。
AI.method: 引入波函数读出机制，把连续NQS映射到格点分辨的电荷与自旋统计量；以填充ν=3的莫尔过渡金属硫族化合物为对象进行研究。
AI.result: NQS揭示出低于自旋极化Wigner分子铁磁晶体的低自旋基态；电荷密度保留三角分子图案，但读出显示通过束缚的近邻双占-空穴对存在显著电荷涨落；每个分子电荷态有惰性自旋单重态核心和承载自旋的边缘电子，电荷与自旋涨落交织，位点间呈反铁磁自旋关联。
AI.conclusion: 该结果启发用自旋双轨道Hubbard模型作为有效描述，并展示了在竞争尺度阻碍受控归约时，从连续波函数通向有效格点模型的路径。

title: Analytical Prediction of Buckling Limits in Isotropic Pentamode Lattices
summary: Pentamode lattices are architected materials characterized by an elastic response dominated by a single deformation mode. The low stiffness of the other deformation modes, however, may result in limited stability under compressive prestress, thereby limiting their mechanical performance. In this work, we develop a general analytical framework to determine the buckling limits of prestressed 2D and 3D isotropic pentamode lattices with generic link geometries. Two distinct instability mechanisms are considered: a global instability associated with the loss of stability of the effective medium, and a local instability associated with finite-wavelength modes at the scale of the lattice cell. Closed-form expressions for the corresponding critical pressures are derived, and the buckling limit is obtained as the lower of the two. The analytical predictions are validated through numerical simulations of different PM lattices, showing good agreement over the configurations considered. The results reveal a trade-off between approaching the pentamode limit and maintaining sufficient buckling resistance, but also show that appropriate link designs can substantially increase the buckling limit while retaining the desired pentamode behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出解析框架，确定一般连接几何下预应力2D/3D各向同性五模晶格（pentamode lattices）的屈曲极限，区分全局失稳与局部有限波长失稳，导出临界压力闭式表达式，并以数值模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 五模晶格由单一变形模式主导，其他模式刚度低，在压缩预应力下稳定性差，限制了其力学性能，因此需要明确其屈曲极限。
AI.method: 建立通用解析框架，针对2D和3D各向同性五模晶格及一般连接几何，分别考虑有效介质整体失稳和晶胞尺度有限波长局部失稳，推导临界压力闭式解，取两者中的较小值作为屈曲极限，并用数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 解析预测与多种五模晶格的数值模拟结果吻合良好；结果揭示了逼近五模极限与保持足够抗屈曲能力之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 合理的连接设计可在保持理想五模行为的同时显著提高屈曲极限，从而缓解五模极限与稳定性之间的权衡。

title: Momentum-Locked Edge Excitons in 2D Molecular Crystals
summary: In molecular crystals, molecular excitations can hybridize into collective Frenkel excitons. Here we show that doubly degenerate excitations in planar two-dimensional molecular crystals generate excitonic bands with nontrivial momentum-resolved topological characteristics and edge states appearing only for selected crystallographic terminations. Using a model inspired by aggregates of zinc phthalocyanine molecules deposited on insulating surfaces, we demonstrate that the existence of edge excitons depends sensitively on the crystallographic orientation of the boundary and is governed by the Zak phase of the underlying bulk bands. The resulting edge states exhibit momentum-locked elliptical polarization textures originating from the internal structure of the molecular excitations, potentially enabling directional optical coupling and excitation transport. Our results establish a route toward topological and polarization-textured excitonic states in two-dimensional molecular materials.

AI.tldr: 二维平面分子晶体中双简并激发形成具有非平凡拓扑特征的Frenkel激子带，边缘激子的存在依赖边界晶向并由体能带的Zak相位决定，且边缘态具有动量锁定的椭圆偏振织构。
AI.motivation: 探索分子晶体中集体Frenkel激子是否可具备拓扑非平凡特性，以及如何利用分子激发的内部结构产生可控的偏振织构边缘态。
AI.method: 构建受锌酞菁分子聚集体（沉积于绝缘表面）启发的模型，分析二维平面分子晶体中双简并激发的激子能带、边缘态及其与Zak相位的关系。
AI.result: 发现激子带具有非平凡动量分辨拓扑特征；边缘激子仅在特定晶向终止处出现，其存在由体能带Zak相位决定；边缘态呈现源自分子激发内部结构的动量锁定椭圆偏振织构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为二维分子材料中拓扑及偏振织构激子态提供了实现途径，有望用于定向光耦合与激发传输。

title: Correspondence between Asymptotic Quantum Many-Body Scars in Closed Systems and Diffusive Nambu-Goldstone Modes in Open Systems
summary: Hydrodynamic relaxation in open quantum many-body systems can be understood in terms of diffusive Nambu--Goldstone (NG) modes associated with strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB). Here, we find a common structure underlying weak ergodicity breaking in closed quantum systems and diffusive hydrodynamics in open quantum systems. We establish a spectral correspondence between the parent Hamiltonian of rainbow quantum many-body scar (RQMBS) states in closed systems and the effective Lindbladian of strongly dissipative open systems with strong $U(1)$ symmetry and local charge-dephasing Lindblad operators. For broad classes of spin, fermionic, and bosonic systems, we construct asymptotic RQMBS (ARQMBS) states. Within the enlarged scar subspace, the parent Hamiltonian admits a local Rokhsar--Kivelson-type frustration-free decomposition. A single-mode variational construction gives an $O(k^2)$ upper bound on its lowest excitation energy and yields states satisfying the defining ARQMBS criteria: orthogonality, vanishing energy variance, and characteristic entanglement scaling. Under vectorization, RQMBS states are mapped to maximally mixed infinite-temperature states in fixed-charge sectors, which exhibit long-range SWSSB order under finite-density conditions. Assuming uniformly bounded positive transition rates, the effective Lindbladian has the same local projectors as the parent Hamiltonian but with positive transition-dependent weights, yielding two-sided spectral bounds and the same system-size scaling of their gaps. For uniform rates, the two operators are proportional to each other and their eigenmodes coincide. Therefore, an exact quadratic parent-Hamiltonian branch maps directly to a diffusive NG mode. Our results connect different mechanisms of slow relaxation in closed and open quantum many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将封闭系统的彩虹量子多体疤痕(RQMBS)母哈密顿量与强耗散开放系统的有效Lindbladian建立谱对应，揭示两者共享同一局域投影结构，从而连接封闭系统的弱遍历性破缺与开放系统的扩散NG模式。
AI.motivation: 封闭量子系统中的弱遍历性破缺（如量子多体疤痕）与开放量子系统中的扩散流体力学（由扩散Nambu--Goldstone模式描述）传统上被视为不同机制，本文旨在找到一个统一的结构来联系二者。
AI.method: 构造自旋、费米子和玻色子系统中的渐近RQMBS态；在扩大的疤痕子空间内给出母哈密顿量的局域Rokhsar--Kivelson型无阻挫分解；用单模变分构造给出最低激发能的O(k²)上界；通过矢量化将RQMBS映射为固定电荷扇区中的最大混合无穷温度态；并假设有界正跃迁率，比较有效Lindbladian与母哈密顿量的谱。
AI.result: 单模变分构造给出O(k²)的最低激发能上界，所得态满足ARQMBS判据（正交性、能量方差为零、特征纠缠标度）；矢量化后RQMBS对应最大混合无穷温度态，在有限密度下具有长程SWSSB序；有效Lindbladian与母哈密顿量共享局域投影子，具有双侧谱界和相同的能隙系统尺寸标度；均匀跃迁率下两算子成正比、本征模重合。
AI.conclusion: 精确的二次母哈密顿量分支直接映射为扩散NG模式，从而统一了封闭与开放量子多体系统中慢弛豫的不同机制。

title: Resolving molecular biexcited states using classical leading-order triples corrections to quantum equation-of-motion UCCSD
summary: Excited electronic states are difficult to accurately and tractably model, particularly those exhibiting multiexcitonic character. Scalable single-reference excited state methods typically fail to describe such states as they suffer from the defects of the mean-field approximation and/or neglect higher-rank excitation operators. To address this, we derive the [T] perturbative correction to the quantum self-consistent equation-of-motion unitary coupled cluster singles and doubles (q-sc-EOM-UCCSD) method. The method captures triple excitation effects through a classical step of second-order in many-body perturbation theory following a q-sc-EOM-UCCSD calculation on a quantum computer. The perturbative correction developed has a $\mathcal{O}(N^7)$ classical computational time scaling. We incorporate [T] into a hybrid compute strategy wherein eigenvectors of the effective Hamiltonian from the hybrid quantum-classical q-sc-EOM-UCCSD algorithm are relayed to a classical computer which performs the postprocessing required for the [T] correction. The benefits of [T] are quantified in a benchmark covering a variety of electronically excited states of the isoelectronic CH$^+$ and BH molecules. We find that the addition of the [T] correction to both trotterized and full operator variants of q-sc-EOM-CCSD can offer dramatic improvements over baseline q-sc-EOM-UCCSD. Our assessment clearly demonstrates the importance of considering higher-rank excitation operators in q-sc-EOM-UCCSD, quantifies the overall success of the [T] correction, and discusses some of its limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对q-sc-EOM-UCCSD方法的[T]微扰修正，通过经典二阶多体微扰理论捕获三重激发效应，以$\mathcal{O}(N^7)$代价改进多重激发态的描述。
AI.motivation: 激发电子态（尤其具多激子特征的态）难以准确且可扩展地建模。单参考激发态方法因平均场近似缺陷及忽略高阶激发算子而失效，需引入高阶激发修正。
AI.method: 推导q-sc-EOM-UCCSD的[T]微扰修正：在量子计算机上完成q-sc-EOM-UCCSD计算后，经典地进行二阶多体微扰理论步骤以捕获三重激发效应，时间标度为$\mathcal{O}(N^7)$。采用混合计算策略，将有效哈密顿量本征矢传递至经典计算机进行后处理。
AI.result: 在等电子CH$^+$与BH分子的多种电子激发态基准测试中，[T]修正（用于trotterized和full operator两种q-sc-EOM-CCSD变体）相较基线q-sc-EOM-UCCSD取得显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明在q-sc-EOM-UCCSD中考虑高阶激发算子的重要性，验证了[T]修正的整体成功，并讨论了其局限。

title: LLM-Assisted Generation of Transparent, Open-Source Multiphysics Models of Electrochemical Devices
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, Supplementary Information and implementation guide provided as ancillary files
summary: Multiphysics continuum models are powerful tools for studying electrochemical devices, enabling in silico reactor design and resolution of local pH, potential, and concentration fields that govern device performance but are difficult to measure experimentally. However, constructing such models requires substantial numerical expertise or reliance on proprietary software. Here, we show that frontier large language model agents can remove this implementation burden while keeping the underlying physics under researcher control. Using one-dimensional electrochemical CO2 reduction to CO in a porous gas diffusion electrode as a test case, we develop a machine-readable, human-specified modeling harness containing governing equations, parameters, numerical methods, logical build stages, and human-verifiable checkpoints. From this specification, the agent reproducibly constructs complete multiphysics models in open-source Julia. Independently built models, including fully autonomous agent-built models, agree with an equivalent COMSOL implementation to within 0.7% of the peak CO partial current density, and with one another to within 0.04%. Systematically planted errors demonstrate the importance of explicit specifications for reproducibility and reveal the agent's capabilities and limitations in debugging model physics. This framework establishes a more transparent approach to multiphysics modeling in which physical descriptions and governing equations, rather than specialized code, become the primary inputs for computational model development.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型智能体可依据人写的机器可读建模规范，自动构建开源Julia多物理场模型，摆脱专有软件依赖，其结果与COMSOL吻合。
AI.motivation: 多物理场连续模型是研究电化学器件的重要手段，可解析局部pH、电势和浓度场，但建模需大量数值专业知识或依赖专有软件，门槛高。
AI.method: 以一维多孔气体扩散电极中CO2还原制CO为测试案例，构建机器可读、人工指定的建模规范（含控制方程、参数、数值方法、构建步骤与可验证检查点），由前沿LLM智能体据此在开源Julia中可复现地构建完整模型。
AI.result: 独立构建的模型（含完全自主智能体构建者）与等效COMSOL实现峰值CO分电流密度偏差在0.7%以内，彼此偏差在0.04%以内；人为植入错误实验证明显式规范对可复现性的重要性，并揭示智能体在调试模型物理方面的能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使物理描述与控制方程而非专门代码成为计算建模的主要输入，建立了更透明的多物理场建模途径。

title: Effect of uniform bond-charge order on longitudinal spin-susceptibility jump at a superconducting instability inside a magnetic phase
summary: A previous work [H. Yamase and M. Zafur, Phys. Rev. B \textbf{103}, 224527 (2021)] showed that the longitudinal spin susceptibility exhibits a jump when the superconductivity develops continuously inside a magnetic phase. That analysis employed a minimal model containing magnetic and superconducting interactions. However, in correlated-electron systems, both magnetic and bond-charge interactions originate from the same underlying spin-spin exchange interaction. We therefore extend the model by including the uniform bond-charge order to provide a more realistic description of the system. We find that the jump of the longitudinal spin susceptibility remains robust even in the presence of uniform bond-charge order, but the uniform bond-charge order quantitatively enhances the longitudinal spin susceptibility and the size of the jump at $T_c$.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了含磁性与超导相互作用的极小模型，加入均匀键电荷序，发现纵向自旋磁化率的跳变在键电荷序存在下依然稳健，且键电荷序在数量上增强了磁化率及T_c处的跳变幅度。
AI.motivation: 已有研究用极小模型发现超导在磁相内连续发展时纵向自旋磁化率出现跳变，但该模型忽略了关联电子体系中磁性与键电荷相互作用源自同一自旋-自旋交换这一事实，需更真实的描述。
AI.method: 在原有含磁性与超导相互作用的极小模型基础上，引入均匀键电荷序，扩展模型以考察其对该跳变行为的影响。
AI.result: 纵向自旋磁化率的跳变在均匀键电荷序存在时依然保持稳健；键电荷序在数量上增强了纵向自旋磁化率以及T_c处的跳变幅度。
AI.conclusion: 磁化率跳变现象对键电荷序具有鲁棒性，且键电荷序定量强化了该效应，表明相关电子体系中需同时考虑磁性与键电荷自由度。

title: Ambipolar metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe2
summary: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Atomically thin semiconductors offer a new test because transport and scanning tunneling microscopy can probe the same material, yet poor contacts impede transport where correlations are strongest. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. Their critical densities differ fourfold yet correspond to comparable Coulomb-to-kinetic-energy ratios, where tunneling microscopy finds solid-liquid coexistence. Magnetoresistance peaks sharply at each transition, reflecting a Pomeranchuk-like, field-driven expansion of the Wigner solid against the correlated liquid. Our results demonstrate interaction-driven transitions in high-quality two-dimensional semiconductors, opening quantitative transport in contact-limited systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用无接触射频反射测量技术，在同一双层MoSe₂器件中同时探测电子和空穴的密度驱动金属-绝缘体转变，发现两种转变的临界密度相差四倍但对应相近的库仑能-动能比，表明相互作用主导了转变。
AI.motivation: 当库仑相互作用主导动能时，稀薄二维载流子会形成Wigner固体，其熔化和无序驱动的局域化都能引起密度调控的金属-绝缘体转变。但二者的相对作用和相互影响争论数十年。原子级薄半导体可同时用输运和STM探测，然而在关联最强处接触质量差，阻碍了输运测量。
AI.method: 引入无接触的射频反射测量技术，通过电容栅耦合感知薄层电阻。在同一双层MoSe₂器件中探测电子和空穴转变，并测量磁阻。
AI.result: 在同一器件中分辨出电子转变和此前难以探测的空穴转变，二者载流子共享相同的无序但质量不同。它们的临界密度相差四倍，却对应可比的库仑能-动能比。STM在此处观测到固-液共存。磁阻在每个转变处出现尖锐峰值，反映Wigner固体在磁场驱动下相对于关联液体的Pomeranchuk式膨胀。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明高质量二维半导体中存在相互作用驱动的转变，并为接触受限系统开辟了定量输运研究的途径。

title: Quasicrystalline oxide interfaces by twisting SrTiO3 membranes
summary: Quasicrystals reveal that long-range order can exist without translational periodicity, but deterministic routes for designing strongly bonded quasicrystalline interfaces remain unexplored. Here, we show that such interfaces can be engineered by growing epitaxial SrTiO3 membranes on a sacrificial layer, releasing them, twisting them by prescribed angles, and bonding them onto a chosen substrate. SrTiO3 bilayers twisted by 45° form an octagonal quasicrystalline interface with eight-fold rotational symmetry, whereas trilayers assembled with successive 30° rotations form a dodecagonal interface with twelve-fold symmetry. Selected-area and nano-beam electron diffraction, multislice electron ptychography, atomic-resolution dark field imaging, Fourier analysis, and real-space tiling establish long-range quasicrystalline order with electronic reconstruction evident from electron energy-loss spectroscopy after annealing. Atomistic simulations based on machine-learned interatomic potentials show that octagonal order emerges as the bilayer twist angle approaches 45°. Polarization-dependent X-ray absorption spectroscopy in 1.5 nm twisted bilayers reveals a twist-dependent electronic response, and terahertz-field-induced second-harmonic generation circular dichroism identifies a symmetry-dependent nonlinear optical response at the 45° quasicrystalline condition. Twisted oxide membranes therefore provide an extendable route to engineer quasiperiodic order and couple it to interfacial bonding, orbital reconstruction, and nonlinear optical response in complex oxides.

AI.tldr: 通过生长、释放、扭转并键合SrTiO3薄膜，可在界面工程化制备具有八重/十二重对称性的准晶界面，并观察到电子重构及非线性光学响应。
AI.motivation: 准晶表明长程有序可在无平移周期性下存在，但强键合准晶界面的确定性设计路线尚未被探索。
AI.method: 在牺牲层上生长外延SrTiO3膜、释放、按预设角度扭转并键合到衬底；双层扭转45°形成八重对称八边形准晶界面，三层连续扭转30°形成十二重对称界面。采用选区与纳米束电子衍射、多切片电子叠层成像、原子分辨暗场成像、傅里叶分析与实空间拼接表征；结合机器学习势的原子模拟、偏振依赖X射线吸收谱及太赫兹场诱导二次谐波圆二色性表征。
AI.result: 确认了长程准晶有序；退火后电子能量损失谱显示电子重构；模拟表明双层扭转角趋近45°时出现八边形有序；1.5 nm扭转双层表现出扭转依赖的电子响应；45°准晶条件下出现对称性依赖的非线性光学响应（圆二色性）。
AI.conclusion: 扭转氧化物膜提供了一条可扩展路径，用于工程化准周期有序，并将其与界面键合、轨道重构及复杂氧化物中的非线性光学响应耦合。

title: Topological Frenkel excitons in 2D molecular crystals
summary: Collective molecular excitations govern energy transport in light-harvesting and optoelectronic materials. Theory predicts that excitonic band topology can generate edge-confined states, offering a route to direct energy flow in molecular systems, yet experimental evidence is lacking. Here we use scanning tunnelling microscopy-induced luminescence to image Frenkel excitons in two-dimensional zinc phthalocyanine molecular crystals with nanometer resolution. By varying cluster size, we observe the transition from discrete quantum-confined excitations to collective excitonic bands and directly resolve their real-space wavefunctions. We identify an excitonic state localized at the crystal perimeter and show, through comparison with microscopic theory, that it originates from the momentum-resolved non-trivial topology of the bulk excitonic bands. Our results establish molecular crystals as a platform for engineering topological excitonic states and provide a strategy for controlling energy transport through excitonic band engineering.

AI.tldr: 该文利用扫描隧道显微镜诱导发光技术，在二维锌酞菁分子晶体中实现了对Frenkel激子的纳米级实空间成像，首次实验观测到由激子能带拓扑产生的边缘局域态。
AI.motivation: 理论上预测激子能带拓扑可产生边缘局域态，为分子体系中的能量定向传输提供途径，但此前缺乏实验证据。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜诱导发光（STML）技术，对不同尺寸的二维锌酞菁分子晶体进行成像；通过改变团簇尺寸，研究从离散量子受限激子到集体激子能带的转变；结合微观理论对实验观测进行对比分析。
AI.result: 观测到从离散量子受限激子到集体激子能带的转变，并直接解析了激子的实空间波函数；识别出定域于晶体边界的激子态，并通过与微观理论对比证明其源于体激子能带的动量分辨非平凡拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了分子晶体作为工程化拓扑激子态的平台，并为通过激子能带工程调控能量传输提供了策略。

title: Heat transport in weakly anharmonic Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chains
summary: We investigate anomalous heat transport in the one-dimensional $β$-Fermi--Pasta--Ulam--Tsingou chain in the weakly anharmonic regime using large-scale equilibrium molecular dynamics. By resolving the heat current into phonon-mode contributions, we show that its long-time autocorrelation is controlled by diagonal mode correlations, whose decay is quantitatively determined by the corresponding phonon damping rates. Extrapolation to the thermodynamic limit gives $Γ_k \propto (βT)^{4/3} k^{5/3}$, with a subleading $k^2$ correction. The latter produces an extended pre-asymptotic regime, $C(t) \sim t^{-4/5}$, before the asymptotic decay $C(t) \sim t^{-3/5}$ is reached, leading to $κ(N) \sim N^{2/5} + O(N^{1/5})$. At weak anharmonicity, off-diagonal mode correlations persist up to a characteristic time $τ_{\mathrm{od}} \sim (βT)^{-2}$, while increasingly large systems are required to resolve the long-wavelength phonon contribution. Weak anharmonicity therefore does not introduce a distinct asymptotic transport mechanism, but shifts the onset of the phonon-dominated regime to progressively longer times and larger length scales.

AI.tldr: 本文用大规模平衡分子动力学研究一维β-FPU链弱非谐区的反常热输运，表明热流长时自相关由对角模态关联主导，其衰减由声子阻尼率决定，收敛到κ(N)~N^{2/5}。
AI.motivation: 理解弱非谐极限下一维FPU链热输运是否引入新的渐近输运机制，以及有限尺寸下声子主导区如何随非谐强度变化。
AI.method: 大规模平衡分子动力学模拟，将热流分解为声子模态贡献，分析对角与非对角模态关联、声子阻尼率，并外推到热力学极限。
AI.result: 阻尼率Γ_k∝(βT)^{4/3}k^{5/3}，含次主导k^2修正；先出现C(t)~t^{-4/5}的前渐近区，后达C(t)~t^{-3/5}，给出κ(N)~N^{2/5}+O(N^{1/5})；非对角关联持续至τ_od~(βT)^{-2}。
AI.conclusion: 弱非谐不产生独立渐近输运机制，只是把声子主导区的起点推向更长时间与更大尺度，并需更大系统分辨长波声子贡献。

title: Accelerating dynamic polarizability calculations of organic molecules using equivariant graph neural networks
summary: Predicting the dynamic polarizability tensor of organic molecules is essential for simulating light-matter interactions in optoelectronic devices, yet conventional quantum-chemical methods such as time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) are computationally expensive and limit large-scale screening. We present an equivariant graph neural network architecture that predicts frequency-dependent, complex-valued dynamic polarizability tensors directly from readily available molecular information, such as 3D geometry and UV-vis spectra. The model learns to approximate the shape and magnitude of the dynamic polarizability tensor, capturing both dispersive and absorptive features that define the molecular optical response. We evaluate the model on molecules from both the QM9 dataset and the Harvard organic photovoltaic dataset using various metrics, including the earth mover's distance, which is suitable for comparing spectral quantities. For both datasets, the model successfully reproduces the main features of the dynamic polarizability tensor and generalizes across diverse molecules. To assess the applicability, we further validated the model using a downstream workflow to calculate the optical properties of organic photovoltaic devices. We used the model-predicted polarizabilities to perform device-level optical simulations, yielding charge carrier generation rates in agreement with TD-DFT-based results ($R^2 = 0.94$). Our approach offers a promising complement, or even an alternative, to conventional methods such as TD-DFT, enabling faster and more efficient screening of photoactive organic molecules for optoelectronic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出等变图神经网络，从分子3D几何与UV-vis光谱直接预测频率相关的复值动态极化率张量，替代昂贵的TD-DFT，用于有机光电分子快速筛选。
AI.motivation: 有机分子动态极化率张量对模拟光电器件中的光-物质相互作用至关重要，但TD-DFT等传统量子化学方法计算成本高，难以支撑大规模分子筛选。
AI.method: 构建等变图神经网络架构，以3D几何和UV-vis光谱等易得信息为输入，学习预测频率相关的复值动态极化率张量，捕捉色散与吸收特征；在QM9和哈佛有机光伏数据集上，用含推土机距离（EMD）在内的多种指标评估。
AI.result: 模型在两个数据集上均成功复现动态极化率张量的主要特征，并能在多样分子间泛化；进一步用于有机光伏器件光学模拟，得到的电荷载流子产生率与TD-DFT结果一致（R²=0.94）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为TD-DFT的有力补充甚至替代方案，实现更快、更高效的光活性有机分子筛选，服务于光电子应用。

title: Correlating DC SQUID Performance with the Location of Trapped Magnetic Flux Using Scanning SQUID Microscopy
summary: Holes in the ground planes of superconducting circuits, commonly referred to as moats, are known to be an effective means of mitigating the deleterious effects of residual magnetic flux in superconducting circuits. Previous studies have utilized scanning SQUID microscopy (SSM) to image the effectiveness of various moat geometries and the maximum magnetic fields where they no longer prevent vortices in the ground plane but have not directly correlated the location of flux with circuit performance measurements. In this study we employ SSM to image the effectiveness of various moat configurations in trapping unwanted flux near a DC SQUID, and when the moats are not effective, the location of vortices in the ground plane. During the same cooldown, and without disturbing the circuit, we measure the circuit performance to directly correlate this with the vortex location. We show that there are preferential pinning sites for fluxons regardless of moat configuration, demonstrating the utility of the SSM in provide feedback for circuit layout, modeling, and failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合扫描SQUID显微镜与电路性能测量，首次直接关联超导电路接地平面中磁通涡旋位置与DC SQUID性能。
AI.motivation: 超导电路接地平面中的残余磁通会引入涡旋，损害电路性能。已知"护城河"（moat，接地平面上的孔洞）能有效缓解该问题，但以往研究仅用扫描SQUID显微镜（SSM）成像护城河几何结构的有效性，未将磁通位置与电路性能直接关联。
AI.method: 在同一次降温过程中，使用SSM对DC SQUID附近多种护城河配置的磁通俘获效果进行成像，并在不扰动电路的情况下测量电路性能，从而将涡旋位置与性能直接对应起来。
AI.result: 护城河在俘获多余磁通时有效，失效时可观测到接地平面中涡旋的位置；无论护城河配置如何，磁通子都存在优先钉扎位点。
AI.conclusion: SSM可与电路性能直接关联，为电路版图设计、建模和失效分析提供反馈，具有实用价值。

title: Multiorbital Anisotropy and Magnetic Excitations in Trilayer Nickelate Pr$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$
comment: Main: 9 pages, 4 figures; Supplementary: 25 pages, 23 figures
summary: Rare-earth substitution strongly modifies the structure, metallicity, and superconducting behavior of Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates, but its impact on their magnetic interactions remains unclear. Here, we combine x-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) to resolve the multiorbital electronic structure and magnetic excitations of Pr$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. The absence of an overlapping rare-earth resonance provides direct access to the Ni $L_3$ edge, while polarization-dependent measurements at the Ni $L$- and O $K$-edges resolve distinct planar and out-of-plane Ni-O hybridization channels. Momentum-resolved RIXS reveals dispersive magnetic excitations that soften toward the incommensurate spin-density-wave wave vector. An effective spin-wave analysis yields a sizable intra-trilayer exchange coupling, comparable to the leading in-plane interactions and robust against rare-earth substitution. Our results identify the multilayer architecture, rather than rare-earth substitution alone, as a key control knob of the magnetic interactions in these materials.

AI.tldr: 本文结合XAS与RIXS研究Pr4Ni3O10的多轨道电子结构与磁激发，发现磁激发朝自旋密度波波矢软化，三层次内交换耦合显著且对稀土取代稳健，指出多层结构而非稀土取代是调控磁相互作用的关键。
AI.motivation: 稀土取代虽强烈改变RP镍酸盐的结构、金属性与超导行为，但其对磁相互作用的影响尚不清晰。
AI.method: 联合X射线吸收谱(XAS)与共振非弹性X射线散射(RIXS)，利用Ni L3边及Ni L边、O K边偏振测量解析面内与面外Ni-O杂化通道，并进行动量分辨RIXS与有效自旋波分析。
AI.result: 动量分辨RIXS显示色散磁激发朝非公度自旋密度波波矢软化；有效自旋波分析给出可观的三层次内交换耦合，与主要面内相互作用相当且对稀土取代稳健。
AI.conclusion: 多层结构（而非稀土取代）是这类材料磁相互作用的关键调控参量。

title: Bottom-Up Prediction of Amorphous Poly(1,3-dioxolane) using Ab Initio Reactive Machine-Learning Force Fields
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Supplementary material is available with the published article
summary: Poly(1,3-dioxolane) (pDXL) is a chemically recyclable polyether that can be synthesized by living cationic ring-opening polymerization with precise control of chain length into the ultra-high-molecular-weight (UHMW) regime, where it acquires enhanced mechanical properties. Like most polymers, however, it has amorphous condensed-phase structure, and diffraction measurements alone cannot resolve the atomistic microstructure that underlies them. In this work, we predict the ensemble of the pDXL microstructures by applying a recently developed AI-accelerated ab initio bottom-up polymer structure prediction (AI$^{2}$-BPSP) framework that simulates the living polymerization of pDXL under experimental synthetic conditions with machine-learning force fields trained within van der Waals-corrected hybrid density functional theory. Partitioning the predicted X-ray and neutron diffraction signal between the growing chain and the surrounding monomer resolves its dominant feature into two counteracting modes: a monomer contribution near $q \approx 1.5$ Å$^{-1}$ that decays as monomer is consumed, and a polymer contribution near $q \approx 1.6$ Å$^{-1}$ that is absent in oligomers and grows with chain length. This work paves the way to direct accuracy validation of these statistically significant, first-principles, and chain-length resolved diffraction predictions against experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用AI加速的从头聚合物结构预测框架(AI²-BPSP)，模拟实验条件下pDXL的活性阳离子聚合，预测其非晶微观结构并解析X射线/中子衍射信号中单体与聚合物链的贡献。
AI.motivation: pDXL是化学可回收聚醚，可活性聚合至超高分子量并获得增强力学性能，但其凝聚相为非晶态，仅靠衍射无法解析原子级微观结构。
AI.method: 采用AI²-BPSP框架，在vdW校正的杂化密度泛函机器学习力场下模拟pDXL活性聚合，并将预测的X射线与中子衍射信号在生长链与周围单体间进行分解。
AI.result: 衍射主特征由两种相反模式构成：q≈1.5 Å⁻¹处随单体消耗而衰减的单体贡献，以及q≈1.6 Å⁻¹处寡聚物中缺失、随链长增长而增强的聚合物贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为这些统计显著、第一性原理、链长分辨的衍射预测与实验的直接精度验证铺平道路。

title: Influence of nonlocal excitonic optical response on in-plane exciton polaritons supported by monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides
summary: Achieving nanoscale light confinement and long-range propagation is a central challenge in nanophotonics, with important implications for controlling molecular photophysical processes and energy transfer. Monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) support in-plane exciton-polaritons (IPEPs), deeply subwavelength optical modes in the visible range. In this regime, electromagnetic fields vary on length scales comparable to the exciton size, making spatial nonlocality in the excitonic optical response essential. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of the nonlocal excitonic optical response and investigate the near-field properties of IPEPs in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-encapsulated monolayer WS$_2$. Combining a two-band massive Dirac fermion description with a generalized Mott-Wannier treatment, we derive a nonlocal electric susceptibility that accounts for both the center-of-mass and internal relative motion of excitons. Spatial nonlocality in the excitonic optical response shifts the polariton dispersion toward lower in-plane wavevectors compared with the results based on the local-response approximation. This reduces high-wavevector contributions and produces smoother near-field distributions that extend over larger lateral distances while retaining nanoscale confinement. Furthermore, at higher excitation energies, multiple exciton-polariton modes contribute at distinct wavevectors, and their relative contributions can be tuned by varying the thickness of the capping hBN layer. These insights elucidate the fundamental role of spatial nonlocality in the polaritonic properties of van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文建立非局域激子光学响应的微观理论，研究hBN封装单层WS₂中的面内激子极化激元(IPEPs)近场特性，揭示空间非局域性对极化激元色散和近场分布的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 实现纳米尺度光局域与长程传播是纳米光子学核心挑战，对分子光物理过程与能量转移有重要意义。单层TMDs支持可见光波段的深亚波长IPEPs，此时电磁场变化尺度与激子尺寸相当，使激子光学响应中的空间非局域性至关重要。
AI.method: 结合两带大质量狄拉克费米子描述与广义Mott-Wannier处理，推导考虑激子质心运动与内部相对运动的非局域电极化率，并研究hBN封装单层WS₂中IPEPs的近场性质。
AI.result: 激子光学响应的空间非局域性使极化激元色散向较低面内波矢移动，相比局域响应近似减少高波矢贡献，产生更平滑、横向延伸更远但保持纳米尺度局域的近场分布。在高激发能量下，多个激子极化激元模在不同波矢处贡献，其相对贡献可通过改变hBN覆盖层厚度调控。
AI.conclusion: 本研究阐明了空间非局域性在范德华异质结极化激元性质中的基础性作用。

title: Percolation on interdependent one-dimensional long-range networks
summary: We study the emergence of a mutual giant component in a multiplex network comprised of two one-dimensional long-range networks on a lattice. The probability that two nodes on one lattice, with a distance $r$ between them, are connected with an edge falls algebraically with distance as $Cr^{-(1+σ)}$, where $0 < σ< 1$ and $0 < C \leq 1$. A mutual giant component exists if $C > C_c^{\mathrm{mul}}$, where $C_c^{\mathrm{mul}}(σ)$ is a critical value of $C$ that is dependent on $σ$. We find rigorous lower bounds on $C_c^{\mathrm{mul}}$, and a tree approximation whose estimate of $C_c^{\mathrm{mul}}$ agrees with simulations within 0.6% for $σ\leq 0.5$. The multiplex network is significantly less stable than the single network case, as is evident by the larger value of $C_c^{\mathrm{mul}}$, which is up to 2.4 times the single-layer value. Our simulations indicate that the order of the transition depends on $σ$. For $σ\leq 0.35$ the mutual giant component collapses abruptly, in a first-order phase transition, while for $σ\geq 0.4$ the transition is continuous. When the dependency links connect random pairs of nodes, the transition is first order for all $σ$.

AI.tldr: 研究两个一维长程网络构成的多层网络中相互巨巨组分的涌现，给出临界值下界与树近似，并探讨相变阶数。
AI.motivation: 探讨多层（相互依赖）网络中巨组分的涌现，特别是在一维长程连边情形下，理解多层结构对网络稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 构建两层一维长程网络：同层节点距离 r 时连边概率为 Cr^{-(1+σ)}（0<σ<1, 0<C≤1）。通过严格推导临界值 C_c^mul(σ) 的下界，并采用树近似估计临界值，与模拟对比。
AI.result: 给出 C_c^mul 的严格下界；树近似在 σ≤0.5 时与模拟误差在 0.6% 内。多层网络明显比单层不稳定，C_c^mul 最高达单层的 2.4 倍。相变阶数依赖 σ：σ≤0.35 为一级（巨组分骤然崩塌），σ≥0.4 为连续相变；当依赖连边连接随机节点对时，所有 σ 均为一级相变。
AI.conclusion: 多层长程网络的存在性阈值显著高于单层，稳定性下降；相变阶数随 σ 及依赖连边方式改变，揭示了多层耦合对临界行为的深刻影响。

title: PEACE: Covariant learning of nonadiabatic manifolds with parity-resolved Hamiltonians
summary: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics provides mechanistic insight into light-driven processes and informs the design of molecules and materials for solar energy conversion, photocatalysis and photo switching. Accurately describing these processes requires a representation that respects electronic symmetry and consistently relates energies to interstate couplings. Here we introduce PEACE, which combines a parity-equivariant latent Hamiltonian with a learned electronic connection. Controlled ablations reveal the complementary roles of symmetry-allowed state mixing and electronic-frame variation in reproducing crossing structures and relaxation dynamics. PEACE closely reproduces excited-state population dynamics from first-principles simulations, while its extension to spin-orbit coupling enables simulations of intersystem crossing. These results demonstrate that a more complete incorporation of the underlying physics into learned electronic representations leads to more accurate predictions of nonadiabatic dynamics.

AI.tldr: PEACE模型结合宇称等变隐哈密顿量与学习到的电子连接，准确预测非绝热分子动力学。
AI.motivation: 非绝热分子动力学对光驱动过程机制理解及太阳能转化、光催化、光开关材料设计至关重要，但需尊重电子对称性并一致关联能量与态间耦合的表示。
AI.method: 提出PEACE，将宇称等变隐哈密顿量与学习到的电子连接相结合；通过受控消融实验分析对称允许态混合与电子框架变化的互补作用。
AI.result: PEACE能复现第一性原理模拟的激发态布居动力学，并扩展至自旋轨道耦合以模拟系间窜越。
AI.conclusion: 更完整地将底层物理融入学习到的电子表示，可更准确预测非绝热动力学。

title: Polarized neutron diffraction with ex-situ $^3$He neutron spin filter and two-dimensional detector for noncollinear incommensurate magnetic order
summary: Polarized neutron scattering has been widely used for studying magnetic orders in condensed matter. A typical setup for this technique is a triple-axis spectrometer with a ferromagnetic single-crystal monochromator and analyzer, which is suited for point-by-point measurements within the horizontal scattering plane. However, this setup cannot fully meet the demands of recent studies on complex magnetic orders with emergent cross-correlated phenomena. For instance, multiferroics, magnetic skyrmions, and other topologically nontrivial magnetic orders tend to have incommensurate magnetic modulation vectors running along various directions in reciprocal space, which cannot be captured by measurements restricted to the horizontal scattering plane. To overcome these limitations, we have developed an experimental setup combining a $^3$He neutron spin filter ($^3$He-NSF) and a two-dimensional (2D) detector, which enables us to analyze the polarization of neutrons scattered away from the horizontal plane. We also establish a data reduction procedure to convert the 2D intensity maps into three-dimensional intensity distributions in reciprocal space, correcting for the effect of imperfect $^3$He polarization. This method is applied to single-crystal diffraction measurements on the multiferroic material Mn$_3$WO$_6$, which exhibits complex incommensurate magnetic orders. We have successfully observed polarization-dependent intensities of out-of-plane incommensurate magnetic reflections, demonstrating the effectiveness of the present method for analyzing complex magnetic structures.

AI.tldr: 提出结合³He中子自旋过滤器与二维探测器的极化中子散射装置及数据还原方法，可测量偏离水平面散射的中子极化，并成功应用于多铁材料Mn₃WO₆的非公度磁序研究。
AI.motivation: 传统三轴谱仪极化中子散射局限于水平散射面内的逐点测量，无法捕捉多铁、磁斯格明子等复杂磁序中沿倒空间各方向延伸的非公度磁调制矢量，因此需要能测量偏离水平面散射中子极化的新方案。
AI.method: 将³He中子自旋过滤器与二维探测器结合，构建可分析偏离水平面散射中子极化的实验装置；并建立数据还原流程，把二维强度图转换为倒空间三维强度分布，同时校正³He极化不完美的影响。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于多铁材料Mn₃WO₆单晶衍射实验，成功观测到面外非公度磁反射的极化依赖强度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效分析复杂磁结构，突破了传统水平面测量的限制，为研究复杂磁序与交叉关联现象提供了有力工具。

title: Deep learning driven framework for optimization of polycrystalline microstructures under competing strength requirements
summary: Computational design of polycrystalline microstructures for enhanced mechanical performance requires repeated high-fidelity simulations over stochastic morphologies, rendering conventional crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) approaches prohibitively expensive for optimization. Here, we develop a deep learning-driven framework for optimizing polycrystalline microstructures under competing quasi-static and dynamic performance requirements. A 3D U-Net surrogate maps polycrystalline copper microstructures directly to full-field velocity histories from plate-impact simulations, preserving the spatial and temporal resolution needed to evaluate dynamic performance and interrogate underlying wave interactions and failure mechanisms. The surrogate is coupled with stochastic microstructure generation and derivative-free optimization to efficiently navigate the design space. To monitor surrogate reliability during optimization, we introduce a distribution-consistent reliability region (DCRR) based on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) to quantify distributional shift from the training data. The framework is demonstrated for multiple design problems, including constrained optimization of spall and yield strengths and inverse design. The optimal designs are validated using CPFE simulations with less than 3% prediction error across all optimization cases, while the surrogate-driven optimization reduces cumulative evaluation time by approximately four orders of magnitude compared with direct CPFE-based optimization. Although demonstrated here for the design of polycrystalline microstructures targeting spall and yield strengths, the framework is broadly applicable to optimization problems where high-fidelity full-field simulations are prohibitively expensive but spatially and temporally resolved response information is essential for evaluating, interpreting, and optimizing candidate designs.

AI.tldr: 提出深度学习驱动的多晶微结构优化框架，用3D U-Net代理模型替代昂贵的晶体塑性有限元模拟，实现准静态与动态性能的快速优化。
AI.motivation: 高保真CPFE模拟在多晶微结构优化中需反复运行，计算成本过高，难以用于优化设计。
AI.method: 构建3D U-Net代理模型，将多晶铜微结构直接映射到板撞击模拟的全场速度历史；结合随机微结构生成与无导数优化；引入基于最大均值差异(MMD)的分布一致性可靠区域(DCRR)监测可靠性与分布漂移。
AI.result: 在层裂强度和屈服强度约束优化及逆向设计等案例中，最优设计经CPFE验证预测误差小于3%，优化评估时间相比直接CPFE减少约四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于高保真全场模拟成本过高但需时空分辨响应信息的优化问题，具有广泛适用性。

title: Gate-driven Switching Dynamics in a Fully Suspended Superconducting Nanowire
summary: A gate voltage can suppress the critical current of a superconducting nanowire, and various scenarios have been proposed to describe these observations. The key difficulty is that these scenarios, including both leakage-driven and field-driven mechanisms, are impossible to disentangle in standard experiments. Here, we resolve this issue by studying a fully suspended superconducting nanowire of amorphous MoGe, separated from the gate by vacuum, eliminating all leakage-driven channels. We measure the phase slip escape rate $Γ$ and find a large gate-induced enhancement of $Γ$, exponential over six orders of magnitude. Fitting various escape-rate models reveals a strong deviation from simple phase slip models, hinting at a complex interaction between the electrostatic field and the phase slip centers. Surprisingly, $Γ$ is not invariant under reversal of the gate-voltage polarity. Our work establishes a clear and nontrivial connection between gate voltage and $Γ$, guiding future research into the origins of the effect.

AI.tldr: 通过全悬浮无泄漏的MoGe超导纳米线实验，证明栅压可显著调控相位滑移逃逸率，且机制非简单场效应。
AI.motivation: 栅压可抑制超导纳米线临界电流，但泄漏驱动与电场驱动机制在标准实验中无法区分，需消除泄漏通道来厘清机制。
AI.method: 制备全悬浮非晶MoGe超导纳米线，用真空隔开栅极以彻底消除泄漏通道；测量相位滑移逃逸率Γ并拟合多种逃逸率模型。
AI.result: 栅压引起Γ大幅增强达六个数量级；拟合显示与简单相位滑移模型强烈偏离，且Γ在栅压极性反转下不守恒。
AI.conclusion: 确立了栅压与Γ之间清晰而复杂的联系，暗示静电场与相位滑移中心存在复杂相互作用，为后续机制研究指明方向。

title: Vortex screening and the fate of the BKT transition with long-range couplings
summary: The stability of the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless phase against long-range interactions remains an open problem. We address this question in the two-dimensional XY model with couplings decaying as $r^{-2-σ}$, by developing a real-space renormalization-group treatment near the Gaussian manifold of quasi-long-range ordered (QLRO) states. We retain the full many-body vortex interaction and show that, at leading order in the fugacity, screening by small vortex--antivortex pairs preserves its Gaussian-average representation without an expansion in the long-range coupling. Including spin waves perturbatively then yields a local stability criterion: a stable QLRO interval exists only for $σ>7/4$. We also investigate a Wilson--Fisher-like fixed point at finite coupling for $σ<7/4$, for which the retained flow predicts $ν^{-1}\sim\sqrt{7/4-σ}$ as it merges with the Gaussian line.

AI.tldr: 研究耦合按 \(r^{-2-\sigma}\) 衰减的二维 XY 模型，发展实空间重整化群方法，发现稳定准长程序列仅当 \(\sigma>7/4\) 时存在。
AI.motivation: BKT 相在长程相互作用下的稳定性尚未解决，本文针对该开放问题进行研究。
AI.method: 在准长程序列的高斯流形附近构造实空间重整化群，保留完整的多体涡旋相互作用，在小逸度下考虑涡旋—反涡旋对屏蔽效应，并微扰引入自旋波。
AI.result: 得到局域稳定性判据：稳定 QLRO 区间仅当 \(\sigma>7/4\) 时存在；对 \(\sigma<7/4\) 研究有限耦合的 Wilson–Fisher 型不动点，预测其与高斯线合并时 \(\nu^{-1}\sim\sqrt{7/4-\sigma}\)。
AI.conclusion: 长程相互作用会破坏 BKT 相稳定性，除非衰减足够快（\(\sigma>7/4\)）；临界指数在 \(\sigma\to7/4\) 时呈现平方根型行为。

title: How Good Is DFT for Solid-Liquid Interfaces? A Comparison With the Random-Phase Approximation for Water on Graphene
summary: Simulations of water at solid interfaces routinely disagree on basic properties, from contact angle to friction, depending on the model used, whether an empirical force field or a density functional theory (DFT) exchange-correlation (XC) approximation. Yet no accurate computational reference has been available to determine which, if any, is reliable. Here we assess XC approximations spanning the rungs of Jacob's Ladder against the random-phase approximation (RPA) at the graphene-water interface. Using machine-learned potentials (MLPs) trained on both DFT and RPA data, we achieve the extensive sampling required to characterize interfacial structure, wettability, friction, and vibrational sum-frequency generation spectra. We find that XC approximations disagree substantially with RPA and with each other. To make sense of this, we introduce a transferable, multi-observable scoring framework that distills each functional's agreement with RPA into a single measure. Six functionals emerge as reliable starting points for studies of graphene-water and other dispersion-dominated interfaces, namely B3LYP-D3(0), revPBE-D3(0), revPBE-D3(BJ), B97M-rV, r$^{2}$SCAN, and revPBE0-D3(0). Notably, this ranking follows no simple rule based on functional family or rung of Jacob's Ladder. What does hold across functionals is that dynamical and spectroscopic properties tend to be harder for DFT to reproduce than structural ones, with direct consequences for functional selection. Our framework also offers a general strategy for benchmarking any atomistic model, including the new generation of foundational MLPs, against high-accuracy references at solid--liquid interfaces. Beyond simulation, this work identifies which models can be trusted to connect measured contact angles, friction, and vibrational spectra to the molecular structure behind them.

AI.tldr: 以RPA为高精度参考，用MLP对石墨烯-水界面广泛采样，评估多种DFT交换关联泛函在界面结构、润湿、摩擦和光谱性质上的表现，并提出多观测指标评分框架，识别出六个可靠泛函。
AI.motivation: 水-固界面模拟结果（接触角、摩擦等）因模型不同（经验力场或DFT泛函）而差异巨大，但缺乏准确的计算参考来判断哪些模型可靠。
AI.method: 在石墨烯-水界面，用机器学习势（MLP）分别基于DFT和RPA数据训练，实现广泛采样，表征界面结构、润湿性、摩擦和振动和频光谱；并引入可迁移的多观测评分框架，将各泛函与RPA的一致性浓缩为单一指标。
AI.result: 不同XC泛函之间及与RPA之间差异显著；六个泛函（B3LYP-D3(0)、revPBE-D3(0)、revPBE-D3(BJ)、B97M-rV、r²SCAN、revPBE0-D3(0)）被识别为可靠起点，且该排名不遵循泛函族或Jacob阶梯层级的简单规律；动力学和光谱性质比结构性质更难被DFT复现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可推广用于评估任何原子模型（包括新一代基础MLP）在固-液界面相对高精度参考的表现；并指明哪些模型可信任地将接触角、摩擦和振动光谱与背后分子结构联系起来。

title: Inhomogeneous cluster DMFT study on p-n junction Mott gap closing in Hubbard lattice
summary: Mott gap closing induced by an external potential gradient is studied by considering the Hubbard model on a square lattice. Our model consists of hole- and electron-doped domains forming the p-n junction where the on-site potential varies smoothly across the interface. The effect of the potential drop direction, either along square edge or diagonal, is studied by describing the correlation effects of inhomogeneous 2x2 plaquette impurity clusters within a dynamical mean-field theory framework. It is found that the metallic phase is favored over the Mott insulators when the potential drop becomes comparable to the energy eigenvalue difference of an open 2x2 plaquette between the ground state and the first excited state. Given the same associated electric-field strength, the excitation energy is almost independent of the drop direction, which amounts ~0.35t at U=5.8t with the hopping parameter t. Upon insulator-to-metal transition, the correlated metal exhibits a coherent peak at zero energy whose intensity is greater for the drop direction along the square diagonal than along the edge. The main origin is attributed to the preserved degeneracy of two molecular orbitals for the former case, while it undergoes splitting in the energy levels for the latter.
