Our result is discussed regarding the experimentally measured Mott gap closing thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文用动力学平均场理论研究了方格子Hubbard模型中由外加电势梯度导致的Mott能隙闭合，发现电势降与2x2团簇激发能相当即发生金属化，且沿对角线方向的金属相干峰更强。
AI.motivation: 探究不均匀电场（如p-n结界面）如何驱动Mott绝缘体向金属转变，并理解电势降方向（沿边或沿对角线）对关联效应的具体影响。
AI.method: 在方格子Hubbard模型上构建空穴掺杂与电子掺杂畴组成的p-n结，在位势跨界面平滑变化；用动力学平均场理论处理非均匀2x2 plaquette杂质团簇的关联效应，比较电势沿边与沿对角线的情形。
AI.result: 当电势降与孤立2x2 plaquette基态到第一激发态的能量差相当时，金属相优于Mott绝缘相；相同电场强度下激发能几乎与方向无关，U=5.8t时约0.35t。绝缘-金属转变后，关联金属在零能处出现相干峰，沿对角线的强度大于沿边，归因于前者两个分子轨道简并保持、后者能级发生劈裂。
AI.conclusion: Mott能隙闭合阈值主要由电势降对应的激发能决定，与方向基本无关；但金属态的光谱权重因方向而异，沿对角线更有利于简并保持和相干峰增强，结果可与实验测量的Mott能隙闭合阈值对比。

title: Optimization-Based Thickness Estimation and Depth-Resolved FIB-Induced Damage Characterization via Multislice Electron Ptychography
comment: 39 pages, 5 figures, 10 supplementary figures, 3 supplementary tables
summary: Quantitative electron microscopy requires accurate knowledge of specimen thickness because dynamical scattering strongly affects image contrast and diffraction intensities. In multislice electron ptychography (MEP), specimen thickness is a required input parameter to its forward model, yet the local thickness of a transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella is often precisely what is unknown. Moreover, thickness is coupled to probe defocus and the number of slices, making its determination from the reconstruction itself nontrivial. Here, we assess whether joint Bayesian optimization of these parameters can provide a physically meaningful estimate of local thickness from four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) data. Applied to a wedge-shaped silicon lamella, the optimization reproduced similar local thickness variation measured by electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS), with a systematic offset of 10-17% relative to the EELS estimates. Using the optimized reconstruction parameters, depth-resolved MEP further separated the crystalline silicon interior from focused ion beam (FIB)-induced amorphous surface layers within the same reconstructed volume. Regions milled at final voltages of 2, 5, 8, and 30 kV yielded amorphous-layer thicknesses of 3.2, 5.0, 7.0, and 26.4 nm, respectively, increasing monotonically with milling voltage and agreeing reasonably with previous cross-sectional measurements. These results show that applying MEP coupled with Bayesian optimization on a single 4D-STEM dataset can provide both local thickness estimates and depth-resolved characterization of FIB-induced damage, offering a route toward more self-consistent, thickness-aware quantitative 4D-STEM analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在多层电子叠层成像(MEP)中联合贝叶斯优化厚度、离焦等参数，从单个4D-STEM数据集获得物理意义明确的局部厚度估计及FIB损伤深度分辨表征。
AI.motivation: 定量电子显微学需要准确的样品厚度，因动力学散射强烈影响衬度和衍射强度。在MEP中，厚度是前向模型的必需输入，但TEM薄片的局部厚度往往正是未知量；且厚度与探针离焦、切片数耦合，难以从重建本身确定。
AI.method: 对4D-STEM数据进行MEP重建参数的联合贝叶斯优化，估计局部厚度；应用于楔形硅薄片，并与EELS测量对比；随后用优化参数进行深度分辨MEP，分离晶态硅与FIB诱导的非晶表面层。
AI.result: 优化重现了与EELS相似的厚度变化趋势，相对EELS存在10-17%的系统性偏差。深度分辨重建分离出非晶层：2、5、8、30 kV最终铣削电压对应的非晶层厚度分别为3.2、5.0、7.0、26.4 nm，随电压单调增加，与已有截面测量吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 在单个4D-STEM数据集上结合MEP与贝叶斯优化，可同时提供局部厚度估计和FIB损伤的深度分辨表征，为实现更自洽、厚度感知的定量4D-STEM分析提供了途径。

title: Self-induced spin-orbit torque switching in a synthetic antiferromagnetic Co 2 MnGa /MnGa bilayer
summary: The large intrinsic spin current in magnetic Weyl semimetals (WSMs) provides a promising platform for spin-orbit torque (SOT) devices. Here, we demonstrate SOTdriven magnetization switching in a synthetic antiferromagnet (SAF) composed of a Co2MnGa(CMG)/MnGa bilayer. In this heavy metal-free structure, CMG film functions simultaneously as a spin current source and as a magnetic layer. Macrospin simulations confirm the self-induced switching mechanism in the bilayer. The SOT generated by CMG switches the MnGa layer, which in turn triggers the reversal of the CMG layer via strong antiferromagnetic exchange coupling. These results elucidate the spin dynamics in SAFs and provide a new pathway toward SOT devices with selfinduced magnetization switching.

AI.tldr: 在无重金属的Co2MnGa/MnGa合成反铁磁双层中实现了自诱导自旋轨道矩驱动的磁化翻转，CMG同时充当自旋流源和磁性层。
AI.motivation: 磁性Weyl半金属具有大本征自旋流，是自旋轨道矩(SOT)器件的理想平台；作者希望探索无重金属结构中SOT驱动的磁化翻转机制。
AI.method: 构建由Co2MnGa(CMG)/MnGa双层组成的合成反铁磁(SAF)结构，通过实验观测SOT驱动的磁化翻转，并用宏自旋模拟验证自诱导翻转机制。
AI.result: CMG产生的SOT先翻转MnGa层，再通过强反铁磁交换耦合触发CMG层反转，实现自诱导磁化翻转；宏自旋模拟确认了该机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究阐明了SAF中的自旋动力学，为具有自诱导磁化翻转的SOT器件提供了新路径。

title: Gaussian Scrooge Ensemble from Deep Thermalization in Free-Fermions
summary: Deep thermalization indicates the emergence of universal ensembles of pure states in a subsystem after measuring its environment. We investigate this phenomenon in a free-fermion chain using local measurements that preserve Gaussianity and break particle-number conservation. Although the measurement outcomes provide partial information about local conserved charges within a finite subsystem, we argue that this information becomes negligible in the thermodynamic limit. This effective non-revelation underlies the emergence of a fermionic Gaussian Scrooge ensemble, determined by the subsystem's generalized Gibbs ensemble. We construct this universal ensemble directly at the subsystem level and provide numerical evidence that it describes the late-time projected ensemble at finite temperature. Our results extend the description of thermalization in non-interacting integrable systems beyond the reduced density matrix to universal statistics of conditional pure states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自由费米子链中的深度热化现象，证明在保持高斯性且破坏粒子数守恒的局域测量下，子系统会涌现出由广义吉布斯系综决定的费米高斯Scrooge系综。
AI.motivation: 深度热化描述了测量环境后子系统纯态普适系综的涌现。作者希望在非相互作用可积系统中，将热化描述从约化密度矩阵推广到条件纯态的普适统计。
AI.method: 在自由费米子链中采用保持高斯性、破坏粒子数守恒的局域测量；论证有限子系统内局域守恒荷的信息在热力学极限下变得可忽略（有效不揭示），并直接在子系统层面构造费米高斯Scrooge系综。
AI.result: 测量结果虽携带有限子系统中局域守恒荷的部分信息，但该信息在热力学极限下可忽略；数值证据表明该普适系综能描述有限温度下的晚期投影系综。
AI.conclusion: 结果将非相互作用可积系统的热化描述从约化密度矩阵扩展到条件纯态的普适统计。

title: Interfacial Water Responds Linearly to Charge yet Is Charge-Asymmetric
summary: The organization of interfacial water shapes the electric double layer behavior in aqueous electrolytes. Asymmetries upon charge reversal are commonly attributed to specific ion adsorption or surface chemistry. Yet it is unresolved whether interfacial water is net oriented at zero charge, and whether such orientation alone makes its response charge-asymmetric. Here, using electrochemical heterodyne-detected sum-frequency generation spectroscopy and constant-potential molecular dynamics simulations, we resolve the absolute orientation of water at a weakly interacting graphene electrode. We show that interfacial water retains a net H-down orientation, with hydrogens pointing toward the bulk, at zero net surface charge. Superimposed on this offset, the field-induced reorientation is linear and symmetric upon charge reversal, independent of how the charge is introduced or distributed. The zero-charge offset therefore shifts the potential of zero water orientation negatively relative to the potential of zero charge, making the interfacial water response intrinsically charge-asymmetric. These results establish an electrostatic baseline against which extrinsic contributions at electrified interfaces can be isolated.

AI.tldr: 利用电化学外差检测和频与恒电势分子动力学，发现弱相互作用石墨烯电极界面水在零电荷时仍保持净H-down取向（氢指向体相），其场诱导重取向线性对称，但零电荷偏移使水取向响应本质呈电荷不对称。
AI.motivation: 双电层中电荷反转时的不对称性通常被归因于特定离子吸附或表面化学。但界面水在零电荷时是否具有净取向、这种取向本身是否单独造成电荷不对称响应，仍未解决。
AI.method: 采用电化学外差检测和频光谱（HD-SFG）与恒电势分子动力学模拟，在弱相互作用石墨烯电极上解析界面水的绝对取向，并考察电荷引入方式与分布的影响。
AI.result: 发现零净表面电荷时界面水呈净H-down取向（氢指向体相）。叠加在此偏移上，场诱导重取向线性且电荷反转对称，与电荷引入方式或分布无关。零电荷偏移使水取向零电位相对零电荷电位负移。
AI.conclusion: 界面水响应本质上具有电荷不对称性，本文建立了可用于分离带电界面外在贡献的静电基线。

title: Unified treatment of local dynamical interactions in correlated metals using Eliashberg theory
summary: First-principles studies of materials with strong electronic correlations introduce additional theoretical complexities and computational costs, even more so if lattice degrees of freedom also play a role. To address these challenges, we show how direct and phonon-mediated electron-electron interactions can be treated consistently. The key observation is that the GW and Fan-Migdal self-energies are topologically the same diagram, so that they can be unified using a single effective interaction, which is the sum of the two interactions. The Dyson equation for the electron Green function then yields normal-state Eliashberg equations, which can be viewed as a subset of the Hedin-Baym equations for coupled electrons and phonons [Phys. Rev. X 13, 031026 (2023)]. We solve these dynamical equations in a local approximation to calculate from first principles the temperature-dependent quasiparticle spectrum, with close attention to the low-energy window determining transport. We apply this extended dynamical Hubbard approach to the correlated metal Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, which has long served as a benchmark system for advanced electronic-structure methods. The resulting renormalization of quasiparticle bands is in qualitative agreement with experiments and results from dynamical mean-field theory. However, here the low-energy linewidth and associated resistivity within the Green-Kubo formalism in the bubble approximation are underestimated, suggesting the need for vertex corrections. This work highlights how simple dynamical formulations can provide an extensible framework for studying correlated materials, which treats electronic and vibrational excitations on equal footing.

AI.tldr: 该文提出统一处理电子-电子（GW）与电声（Fan-Migdal）自能的扩展动力学Hubbard方法，应用于Sr₂RuO₄计算准粒子谱与电阻率。
AI.motivation: 强关联材料中电子关联与晶格自由度同时起作用时，理论复杂度和计算成本大幅增加，需要一致处理直接与声子介导的电子-电子相互作用。
AI.method: 观察到GW与Fan-Migdal自能在拓扑上是同一费曼图，用两者之和的单一有效相互作用统一。由电子格林函数Dyson方程得到常态Eliashberg方程，视为Hedin-Baym耦合电子-声子方程的子集。在局域近似下求解动力学方程，第一性原理计算温度依赖准粒子谱，并用Green-Kubo气泡近似求电阻率。
AI.result: 在关联金属Sr₂RuO₄中，准粒子带的重整化与实验及动力学平均场理论定性一致；但低能线宽与相应电阻率被低估，表明需要顶点修正。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了简单动力学公式可作为可扩展框架研究关联材料，将电子与振动激发置于同等地位。

title: Vanishing Altermagnetism and Emergent Ferromagnetism at the Two-Dimensional Limit of CrSb
summary: Altermagnets offer a promising route to spintronic devices by combining spin-split electronic states with zero net magnetization, but how reduced dimensionality reshapes their magnetic order remains poorly understood. Here, we grow bilayer-thickness CrSb (0001) films directly on SrTiO3(001) substrates by molecular beam epitaxy and uncover an unexpected thickness-dependent magnetic transition. The one-bilayer films exhibit room-temperature ferromagnetism with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, whereas ferromagnetism vanishes in two-bilayer films, contrasting sharply with the altermagnetic ground state of bulk CrSb. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the exposed Cr surface induces orbital rearrangement that strengthens intralayer ferromagnetic exchange while suppressing competing interlayer antiferromagnetic coupling, driving the dimensional crossover from altermagnetism to ferromagnetism. These findings establish dimensionality and surface termination as powerful controls of magnetic order and provide a platform for engineering ultrathin magnetic states for spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过MBE在SrTiO3(001)上生长双层厚度CrSb(0001)薄膜，发现厚度依赖的磁性转变：1个双层表现为室温铁磁且具强垂直磁各向异性，2个双层铁磁消失，与块体CrSb的反铁磁基态形成对比。DFT揭示暴露Cr表面诱导轨道重排，增强层内铁磁交换、抑制层间反铁磁耦合，驱动维度交叉。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体（altermagnets）结合自旋劈裂电子态与零净磁化，是自旋电子学器件的潜力材料，但低维化如何重塑其磁序尚不清楚，需探究维度与表面效应对磁序的调控。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延（MBE）在SrTiO3(001)衬底上直接生长双层厚度CrSb(0001)薄膜，并进行厚度依赖磁性测量；结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析表面诱导的轨道重排与交换耦合变化。
AI.result: 1个双层薄膜呈现室温铁磁性及强垂直磁各向异性；2个双层薄膜铁磁性消失，显著区别于块体CrSb的交替磁基态。DFT表明暴露Cr表面引起轨道重排，增强层内铁磁交换并抑制层间反铁磁耦合，导致从交替磁到铁磁的维度交叉。
AI.conclusion: 维度与表面终止是调控磁序的有力手段，为自旋电子学中超薄磁性态的工程化提供了平台。

title: Construction-Dependent Floquet Topology in Circularly Driven $N$-Stacked Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chains
summary: We investigate construction-dependent Floquet topology in a two-dimensional lattice formed by stacking Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains with co-located sublattice orbitals. We present two constructions in the decoupled-chain limit. Construction-I: the constituent SSH chains are topologically trivial with winding number $w=0$. Construction-II: the constituent SSH chains are topologically nontrivial with $w=1$. Although these constructions are unitarily equivalent in the static limit, circular driving distinguishes them because the hopping processes related by the transformation correspond to different physical bond vectors and therefore acquire different Peierls phases. Using the Floquet-Sambe formalism, we determine the quasienergy spectra and phase diagrams in terms of the lower-band Chern number $C_L$ and directional Zak phases $(Z_x,\, Z_y)$. We find distinct Floquet phase structures, including low-frequency phases with $C_L = -3$ and $C_L = -4$ in the two constructions. Since the Chern number does not resolve the topology of the two quasienergy gaps separately, we further calculate the dynamical winding numbers $W_0$ and $W_π$, and verify the corresponding chiral edge states. In particular, at identical driving parameters, both constructions can have the same Chern numbers $C_L=-2$, while their gap-resolved winding numbers are $(W_0,\, W_π)=(0,\,+2)$ and $(-2,\,0)$, respectively. We also calculate the time-averaged optical Hall conductivity and show that $ C_Le^2/h$ determines its dc value for ideal full-band occupation. At the same time, its finite-frequency response contains photon-assisted contributions. Our results demonstrate that the physical construction of the constituent chains, although irrelevant to the static bulk spectrum, can play a decisive role in the Floquet topological structure. We discuss possible experimental realizations of the driven model.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究二维SSH链堆叠晶格中依赖于"构造方式"的Floquet拓扑：静态下等价的两种构造在周期驱动下因Peierls相位不同而产生不同的Floquet相图。
AI.motivation: 静态极限下两种构造单幺等价、拓扑平凡与非平凡链无区别，但作者想探究这种"构造选择"是否在Floquet驱动下变得物理可观，从而揭示构造对Floquet拓扑的决定性作用。
AI.method: 构建两种SSH链堆叠的二维晶格（Construction-I: w=0，Construction-II: w=1），引入圆偏振驱动使不同物理键矢量获得不同Peierls相位；用Floquet-Sambe形式计算准能谱、下带Chern数C_L与方向Zak相位(Z_x, Z_y)，并进一步计算动力学绕数W_0、W_π、手征边缘态和时间平均光学霍尔电导率。
AI.result: 两种构造呈现不同的Floquet相结构，包括低频下的C_L=-3和C_L=-4相；相同驱动参数下两者可有相同C_L=-2，但能隙分辨绕数为(W_0,W_π)=(0,+2)与(-2,0)；光学霍尔电导率dc值为C_Le²/h，有限频响应含光子辅助贡献。
AI.conclusion: 组成链的物理构造虽与静态体谱无关，却对Floquet拓扑结构起决定性作用；指出了可能的实验实现方案。

title: Effective-Geometry Rescaling and Universal Critical Behavior in the Anisotropic Three-State Potts Model on the Square Lattice
summary: We study the two-dimensional anisotropic three-state Potts ferromagnet on the square lattice using Wolff single-cluster Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling. For coupling ratios $λ=J_y/J_x=0.5$, $0.75$, and $1$, finite-size scaling of the correlation ratio yields critical behavior consistent with the two-dimensional three-state Potts universality class. The scaling of the leading Fisher zeros gives a correlation-length exponent consistent with $ν=5/6$, while their cumulative density is consistent with the expected specific-heat exponent $α=1/3$. We further characterize the anisotropy at criticality using directional correlation ratios $R_x$ and $R_y$ together with directional FK wrapping probabilities. For $λ=0.5$ on a physically square lattice, $R_x$ and $R_y$ approach distinct critical values while yielding a common correlation-length exponent. From the wrapping probabilities, we independently determine an effective aspect ratio $ρ_e^\square=0.6413(5)$, in close agreement with the theoretical value $ρ_e^{\square,\mathrm{th}}\simeq0.64150030$ obtained from the isoradial representation. Using the theoretical value to set the physical aspect ratio restores directional equivalence, $R_x\simeq R_y$, and brings the overall correlation ratio toward the isotropic-square reference. The results show that spatial anisotropy changes the effective critical geometry without altering the bulk three-state Potts universality class.

AI.tldr: 该文用Wolff单团簇Monte Carlo与有限尺寸标度研究二维各向异性三态Potts铁磁体，发现空间各向异性只改变有效临界几何，不改变三态Potts普适类。
AI.motivation: 探究空间各向异性（J_y/J_x≠1）是否会改变二维三态Potts模型的临界普适行为，以及各向异性如何影响有限尺寸标度中的方向相关量与有效几何。
AI.method: 在方格子上对耦合比λ=0.5、0.75、1的体系进行Wolff单团簇Monte Carlo模拟，采用有限尺寸标度分析关联比、Fisher零点（领头及累积密度）、方向关联比R_x、R_y以及方向FK缠绕概率，并用等径向表示的理论长宽比进行检验。
AI.result: 关联比标度与二维三态Potts普适类一致；领头Fisher零点给出ν=5/6，累积密度与α=1/3一致。λ=0.5时R_x与R_y趋于不同临界值但有共同ν。由缠绕概率独立定出有效长宽比ρ_e^□=0.6413(5)，与等径向理论值0.64150030接近。
AI.conclusion: 采用理论长宽比可恢复方向等价（R_x≈R_y）并使整体关联比接近各向同性方格参考值。空间各向异性改变有效临界几何但不改变体相三态Potts普适类。

title: Nonuniform Screening Reshapes Collective Excitons in Molecular Aggregates from Stochastic Bethe-Salpeter Theory
summary: We build and apply an $\textit{ab initio}$ stochastic Bethe-Salpeter Equation (sBSE) approach to planar cyanine dye aggregate clusters containing up to 2,856 valence electrons. Using a transferable, parameterized screened exchange kernel, we resolve dielectric response, exciton delocalization, and optical spectra within a unified many-body framework. Remarkably, the sBSE transition densities validate the Frenkel exciton picture in real space and provide a practical first-principles route to its screened couplings. The calculations reproduce $\textit{H}$-, $\textit{I}$-, and $\textit{J}$-like spectral evolution and reveal that spatially dependent screening does not merely shift excitonic bands, but reshapes their dispersion, leading to changes in the relative energies of bright and dark exciton states. These results establish sBSE as a predictive framework for large molecular aggregates.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了从头算随机Bethe-Salpeter方程(sBSE)方法，应用于含多达2856个价电子的花菁染料聚集体，统一处理介电响应、激子离域和光谱，验证了Frenkel激子图像并揭示了空间依赖屏蔽对激子色散的调控。
AI.motivation: 大分子聚集体中激子行为（离域、屏蔽、光谱）需在统一的多体框架下描述，而现有方法难以兼顾规模与第一性原理的准确性。
AI.method: 构建并应用从头算随机Bethe-Salpeter方程(sBSE)方法，结合可迁移的参数化屏蔽交换核，求解大尺寸花菁染料聚集体簇的光谱与激子性质。
AI.result: sBSE跃迁密度在实空间验证了Frenkel激子图像，并给出其屏蔽耦合的第一性原理路线；计算重现了H-、I-、J-型光谱演化，发现空间依赖屏蔽不仅移动激子带，还重塑其色散并改变明/暗激子相对能量。体系规模可达2856个价电子。
AI.conclusion: sBSE是适用于大分子聚集体的预测性理论框架。

title: Efficient Optimization of Tensor Rings with Low-Rank Environments
summary:
Tensor-ring (TR) decompositions provide a natural representation of periodic systems but are difficult to optimize because the closed geometry prevents a global canonical form and leads to costly, ill conditioned environments. Existing periodic DMRG methods alleviate this difficulty by compressing long environments to a low-rank representation, reducing local operations to $\mathcal{O}(pχ^3)$, where $p$ is the retained environment rank. Here, we extend this approach to an efficient two-site Ring-DMRG algorithm and improve its numerical robustness through appropriate gauge transformations and a generalized Davidson solver. A central challenge in the two-site formulation is the truncation step, which must account for the surrounding environment. When this environment is sufficiently separable, a suitable change of frame reduces the truncation to an ordinary SVD. When it is not separable, we instead use an alternating optimization that retains the full environment.
  The computational advantage of tensor rings over tensor trains depends on the scaling of the required environment rank $p$ with bond dimension and system size. For critical systems, the divergent correlation length makes long-range observables remain sensitive to the periodic geometry as the thermodynamic limit is approached. In this regime, the environment rank required to reach a fixed accuracy in the observable does not grow with the system size. Ring-DMRG therefore retains the same cubic scaling with bond dimension as standard DMRG, but at a substantially smaller bond dimension. The low-rank environment construction also provides a systematic generalization of belief propagation (BP), with standard BP recovered in the rank-one limit.

AI.tldr: 本文将周期性DMRG的环境压缩方法扩展到双位点Ring-DMRG，通过规范变换与广义Davidson求解器提升鲁棒性，并给出临界系统中张量环相对张量链的计算优势分析。
AI.motivation: 张量环(TR)能自然表示周期系统，但闭合几何导致缺乏全局规范形式，环境病态且昂贵；已有周期DMRG靠低秩压缩环境降低代价，本文欲进一步实现高效稳定的双位点算法。
AI.method: 扩展低秩环境压缩到双位点Ring-DMRG；用规范变换和广义Davidson求解器增强数值稳定性；截断时若环境可分离则变换坐标系化为普通SVD，否则用保留完整环境的交替优化；低秩环境构造系统化推广了信念传播(BP)，秩一极限回到标准BP。
AI.result: 局部操作降至O(pχ^3)，p为保留环境秩；临界系统中达到固定观测量精度所需的环境秩不随系统尺寸增长，Ring-DMRG保持与标准DMRG相同的对键维度的立方scaling，但所需键维度显著更小。
AI.conclusion: 双位点Ring-DMRG在临界周期系统中兼具效率与鲁棒性，环境秩不随尺寸增长是其相对张量链优势的关键，并统一了低秩环境与BP框架。

title: Ab-initio Investigation on h-Be3N2 Monolayer for Photocatalytic Hydrogen Evolution Reaction and Oxygen Evolution Reaction
summary: In this work, we have systematically investigated the structural stability, electronic properties, and photocatalytic performance of the 2D h-Be3N2 monolayer for water splitting application, utilizing a first-principles density functional theory. Electronic structure calculations based on the PBE functional reveal that h-Be3N2 is a direct band-gap semiconductor with a band gap value of 1.74 eV, making it well suited for visible-light-driven photocatalysis. Furthermore, the alignment of band-edges illustrates that h-Be3N2 has suitable redox potential that facilitate overall photocatalytic water splitting in neutral and alkaline environment. Conversely, in acidic condition, the position of valence band is an adequate to enable the OER, thereby leading to photocathodic behavior. At neutral pH, the HER process is still possible with the application of an external potential of 0.77 V. For the OER process, it is thermodynamically favourable only under strongly alkaline conditions, while an external potential of 0.43 V is needed to promote the reaction at neutral pH. These results clearly underscore the significant impact of solution pH and photogenerated charge carriers on the photocatalytic effectiveness of the h-Be3N2 monolayer. Furthermore, the study of H coverage indicates that the amount of H that adheres to the surface has a considerable impact on the efficiency of the HER in h-Be3N2. The favourable photocatalytic capabilities of the h-Be3N2 monolayer imply that it might be a viable option for upcoming solar-powered green hydrogen generation and may assist in realizing the goals of the National Green Hydrogen Mission by facilitating effective and sustainable hydrogen production.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理DFT系统研究了二维h-Be3N2单层的结构稳定性、电子性质及光催化水分解性能。
AI.motivation: 探索适用于可见光驱动整体水分解的高效二维光催化剂，服务于太阳能绿色制氢需求。
AI.method: 采用基于PBE泛函的第一性原理密度泛函理论，计算能带结构、带边位置，并考察pH、光生载流子及H覆盖度对HER/OER的影响。
AI.result: h-Be3N2为带隙1.74 eV的直接带隙半导体，适合可见光催化；中性与碱性条件下带边满足整体水分解，酸性下呈光电阴极行为；中性pH下HER需0.77 V外压，OER仅在强碱性下热力学有利、中性下需0.43 V；H覆盖度显著影响HER效率。
AI.conclusion: 溶液pH、光生载流子及表面H覆盖度显著影响h-Be3N2的光催化性能；其良好光催化能力有望用于可持续太阳能制氢，助力国家绿色氢能使命。

title: Programmable Asymmetric Spin-Orbit Torque Switching for Spin Logic
summary: Spin logic devices provide a promising route toward ultralow-power and nonvolatile information processing. In this work, we demonstrate field-free spin-orbit torque-induced asymmetric magnetization switching in in-plane anisotropy (IMA) and perpendicular magnetic anisotropy heterostructures, characterized by different critical switching currents under opposite current polarities. Combined experiments and macrospin simulations reveal that the asymmetric switching originates from an in-plane effective field Hy , which breaks the Myz mirror symmetry of the system. By controlling the magnetization direction of the IMA layer, both the switching polarity and bias direction can be tuned. Building on four distinct types of asymmetric switching behaviors, we realize a reconfigurable spin logic operation within a single Hall-bar device. These results clarify the physical origin of asymmetric magnetization switching and demonstrate an approach for realizing reconfigurable spin logic devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作实现了无磁场自旋轨道力矩诱导的非对称磁化翻转，并基于四种非对称翻转行为在单一霍尔条器件中实现可重构自旋逻辑运算。
AI.motivation: 自旋逻辑器件有望实现超低功耗、非易失的信息处理，但需要无需外场即可工作的机制，并厘清非对称磁化翻转的物理起源。
AI.method: 在面内各向异性(IMA)与垂直磁各向异性异质结中，通过实验与宏观自旋模拟相结合，研究自旋轨道力矩诱导的无场非对称磁化翻转。
AI.result: 观察到相反电流极性下不同临界翻转电流的非对称翻转，其源于打破Myz镜像对称的面内有效场Hy；通过控制IMA层磁化方向可调节翻转极性与偏置方向，并基于四种非对称翻转行为实现可重构自旋逻辑运算。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了非对称磁化翻转的物理起源，并展示了实现可重构自旋逻辑器件的途径。

title: Trend formation with sparse global sampling
summary: Achieving global coordination without a central controller or dense global communication is a defining challenge for both biological collectives and engineered swarms. We introduce and analyze a minimal model in which self-propelled agents in a bounded domain periodically reorient their motions toward the centroid of a small, randomly chosen subset of their peers, with no direct sensing of any individual neighbor's position or heading. We show that this sparse, non-local sampling rule reliably drives an initially disordered population to a globally aligned, nematic state, and that shrinking the sampled subset -- down to the minimum of two agents -- accelerates ordering rather than impeding it: the resulting estimation noise, filtered through a geometric turning rule, is itself the engine of symmetry breaking. We derive an analytical criterion, in quantitative agreement with simulation, that predicts when this ordering succeeds as a function of the sampling size and sampling frequency. We confirm the mechanism experimentally in a swarm of up to fifteen differential-drive robots. These results identify sparse random sampling as an information-efficient route to collective coordination, with implications for understanding animal collectives and for designing communication-limited robotic swarms.

AI.tldr: 自驱动个体仅周期性采样少量随机同伴的质心方向即可实现全局向列对齐；采样子集越小反而排序越快。
AI.motivation: 生物集群与工程集群都需在无中心控制、无密集通信下实现全局协调，现有认知缺乏对这种极简机制的定量与实验验证。
AI.method: 提出极简模型：有界区域内自驱动个体周期性朝随机选出的少量同伴质心重新定向，个体不感知任何邻居的具体位置与朝向；推导解析判据并与仿真对照，同时用最多15台差速驱动机器人验证。
AI.result: 该稀疏非局域采样规则能可靠将无序群体驱动至全局对齐的向列态；将采样数缩至最少两台反而加速排序，而非阻碍；解析判据在采样数与采样频率对排序成败的预测上与仿真定量一致；机器人实验确认了该机制。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏随机采样是通往集群协调的信息高效途径，对理解动物集群及设计通信受限的机器人集群具有意义。

title: Cotunneling-Assisted Redistribution of Nonpassivity in a Photosynthetic Junction
comment: Contains Supplementary Information. Suggestions on references are welcome
summary: We investigate how cotunneling affects passive-state ordering in a Photosystem II reaction center modelled as a nonequilibrium molecular junction. We use a full pigment excitation manifold, with excitonic and charge-transfer rates computed within a Nakajima-Zwanzig formalism using realistic spectral densities. Cotunneling is introduced through a microscopically constructed doubly reduced acceptor state obtained from relevant quinone-side two-electron configurations, while photoexcitation is allowed into the full excitonic manifold. Passive-state permutations are quantified through ergotropy and energetic capacitance. We find that thermodynamic smoothness in ergotropy and energetic capacitance can conceal microscopic state rearrangements. Cotunneling redistributes the extractable nonequilibrium energy among the quinone acceptor, the donor-pheophytin radical pair, and excitonic states with strong contributions from pigments on the inactive branch. At high Coulomb interaction, cotunneling produces no passive-state reordering. Piecewise-linear relations among ergotropy, energetic capacitance, and mean energy further reveal the population reorderings generated by cotunneling.

AI.tldr: 该文研究光系统II反应中心作为非平衡分子结时，共隧穿如何影响被动态排序，发现热力学平滑性可掩盖微观态重排。
AI.motivation: 探究共隧穿对光系统II反应中心被动态排序的影响，揭示热力学量平滑性背后可能的微观态重排。
AI.method: 将PSII反应中心建模为非平衡分子结，采用完整色素激发流形，用Nakajima-Zwanzig形式结合真实谱密度计算激子与电荷转移速率；通过醌侧双电子构型构造双还原受体态引入共隧穿，并用ergotropy与能量电容量化被动态置换。
AI.result: ergotropy与能量电容的热力学平滑性可掩盖微观态重排；共隧穿在醌受体、供体-脱镁叶绿素自由基对及激子态间重新分配可提取非平衡能，非活性分支色素贡献显著；高库仑相互作用下共隧穿不产生被动态重排；ergotropy、能量电容与平均能量间的分段线性关系揭示了共隧穿引起的布居重排。
AI.conclusion: 共隧穿显著影响PSII反应中心的非平衡能量分配与被动态排序，且热力学平滑性可能隐藏微观重排，需借助分段线性关系等细致分析来识别。

title: Fourth-order perturbation theory for the Frohlich polaron: Analytic structure of the weak-coupling series and the crossover to strong coupling
summary: We calculate the Rayleigh-Schrodinger perturbation series for the ground-state energy and the effective mass of the three-dimensional Frohlich polaron through fourth order in the coupling constant alpha. The third- and fourth-order coefficients of the effective mass are new. Because the Frohlich interaction is a form-bounded perturbation of an isolated nondegenerate ground state at fixed total momentum, the series has a nonzero radius of convergence, and we analyze it with the ratio and Pade methods appropriate to convergent series. The coefficients are strikingly regular and are described by a simple power-law singularity at alpha near 8.5 with an exponent near 1.4. The couplings at which successive truncations of the inverse mass vanish, the first of which is the textbook breakdown value alpha = 6, are slowly converging estimates of this radius. Pade approximants built from the weak-coupling coefficients alone agree with diagrammatic Monte Carlo results for the mass to better than one percent for alpha up to 5. Exact results on the analyticity of the ground state and on the strong-coupling asymptotics imply that the coefficients cannot keep a constant sign, although all known coefficients do, so that the apparent singularity must be a complex-conjugate pair close to the positive real axis. It marks the crossover to strong coupling: the weak-coupling series locates this crossover accurately but cannot be continued through it.

AI.tldr: 计算三维Frohlich极化子基态能量与有效质量的Rayleigh-Schrodinger微扰级数至α四阶，发现三、四阶有效质量系数为新结果；级数呈现近α≈8.5、指数约1.4的幂律奇异，为强耦合交叉点。
AI.motivation: Frohlich极化子微扰级数的收敛性与强耦合交叉机制尚不清楚，且此前缺乏有效质量的高阶（三、四阶）系数，需借此判断弱耦合级数的适用范围与奇异结构。
AI.method: 利用Frohlich相互作用是孤立非简并基态的形式有界微扰、级数具非零收敛半径的事实，用比值法与Pade方法分析收敛级数；并由弱耦合系数构造Pade近似。
AI.result: 系数高度规则，可由α≈8.5处指数约1.4的幂律奇异描述；逆质量逐阶截断零点缓慢趋近该半径，首个为教科书值α=6；弱耦合Pade近似在α≤5内与图Monte Carlo吻合优于1%。
AI.conclusion: 该表观奇异必为靠近正实轴的复共轭对，标记向强耦合的交叉；弱耦合级数能准确确定交叉位置，但无法延续穿越该交叉。

title: Anomalous Hall enhancement in fully compensated non-collinear antiferromagnetic Cr-doped Mn3Sn
summary: The non-collinear antiferromagnet (AFM), Mn3Sn, exhibits ultrafast spin dynamics and negligible stray fields, making it a promising candidate for fast and energy-efficient spintronic devices. However, its practical applications remain limited by the relatively small Hall response compared with ferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate through both first-principles calculations and experiments that Cr-doping is a promising strategy to enhance the anomalous Hall transport in Mn3Sn without breaking the antiferromagnetic order. Our first-principles calculations reveal an effective Cr-doping window that enhances the anomalous Hall conductivity while largely preserving the host coplanar inverse triangular AFM order. Berry curvature and Wannier Hamiltonian analyses further reveal that Cr substitution amplifies the pre-existing Berry curvature hotspots through coordinated changes in the energy alignment, local interband gap, and Mn-derived orbital weight of the relevant bands. Experimentally, we have found that Cr doping not only supports our computational predictions (enhancement of the anomalous Hall conductivity), but also suppresses the transition to helical or spin-glass phases at low temperatures. These findings demonstrate that Cr-doping is an effective strategy for stabilizing the AFM order while simultaneously improving the anomalous Hall transport properties over a wide temperature range in Mn3Sn.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理与实验证明，Cr掺杂可在不破坏Mn3Sn反铁磁序的前提下增强其反常霍尔输运，并抑制低温螺旋/自旋玻璃相变。
AI.motivation: Mn3Sn作为非共线反铁磁体具有超快自旋动力学和极低杂散场，是快速节能自旋电子器件的理想候选，但其霍尔响应较铁磁体偏小，限制了实际应用，因此需要寻找增强反常霍尔输运而不破坏反铁磁序的方法。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算与实验。计算方面确定有效的Cr掺杂窗口，分析Berry曲率与Wannier哈密顿量；实验方面制备Cr掺杂Mn3Sn并测量其输运性质。
AI.result: 第一性原理计算发现存在一个有效Cr掺杂窗口，可在基本保持共面反三角反铁磁序的同时增强反常霍尔电导；Berry曲率和Wannier分析表明Cr替代通过能级对齐、局域带隙及Mn轨道权重的协同变化放大已有Berry曲率热点。实验证实Cr掺杂不仅支持计算预测（反常霍尔电导增强），还抑制了低温下向螺旋相或自旋玻璃相的转变。
AI.conclusion: Cr掺杂是一种既能稳定Mn3Sn反铁磁序，又能在宽温区内改善其反常霍尔输运性能的有效策略。

title: Topological and kinetic origins of fractional thermal conductance at the topological insulator--superconductor interface
summary: A recent experiment by Roy et al. (Nat. Commun. 17, 2853 (2026)) demonstrated a robust half-integer thermal conductance plateau, κ_0 T/2, at a bipolar (ν,ν')=(2,-1) junction in bilayer graphene, produced not by non-Abelian topology but by full equilibration of co-propagating electron and hole edge modes. We prove a theorem that fixes when the two origins can be told apart: under full thermal equilibration, the two-terminal thermal conductance of a network of chiral edge segments joined at ideal floating contacts is a rational function of the net chiral central charges of the segments alone, quantities pinned by the gravitational anomaly and invariant under arbitrary local boundary kinetics. The corollary is an impossibility statement: whenever two realizations present the same anomaly data to the same network, no thermal-conductance measurement can distinguish them. That the equilibrated (2,-1) value equals the central charge of a chiral Majorana mode is an arithmetic fact about one filling combination, but wherever such a coincidence occurs it is beyond the reach of thermometry, and the separation must come from the charge sector, which is not anomaly-pinned at a superconducting boundary. We develop the topological insulator-superconductor interface as the application: a vortex carries fractional charge e/4 from the θ= πmagnetoelectric coupling, the boundary hosts a chiral Majorana mode of central charge 1/2, and a laterally adjacent integer quantum Hall (IQH) region supplies the kinetic realization. The Lorenz ratio (anomalous for the isolated Majorana boundary, L_0 / (1 + 4|ν_{IQH}|) in the composite device) and the excess shot noise (growing with B from e/4 vortex tunneling versus locked to IQH plateaus) together resolve the mechanism, provided the quantum Hall edge does not abut the superconductor.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个定理：在完全热平衡下，由理想浮动接触连接的手性边缘段网络，其两端热导仅是各段净手性中心荷的有理函数，这些量由引力反常钉定、对局域边界动力学不变。由此推出不可能性定理：若两种实现给同一网络相同的反常数据，热导测量无法区分。以此分析双层石墨烯(2,-1)结的半整数热导平台，指出其与手性Majorana模式的巧合超出测温能力，必须靠电荷部门区分。
AI.motivation: 实验观察到双层石墨烯(2,-1)结出现κ_0T/2半整数热导平台，但它源于电子-空穴边缘模式完全平衡而非非阿贝尔拓扑。需要判定两种起源何时可被区分，明确热导测量的根本极限，并寻找可靠的区分手段。
AI.method: 证明关于手性边缘段网络热导的定理：在完全热平衡与理想浮动接触下，两端热导是各段净手性中心荷的有理函数，由引力反常钉定且对局域边界动力学不变。据此推导不可能性定理；并发展拓扑绝缘体-超导体界面应用，结合涡旋分数电荷e/4、中心荷1/2手性Majorana模式、以及侧向近邻IQH区域提供动力学实现，利用Lorenz比与过剩散粒噪声作为分辨工具。
AI.result: 平衡后的(2,-1)数值等于手性Majorana模式的中心荷仅是某一填充组合的算术巧合；凡此巧合处测温均无法区分，必须借助电荷部门。复合器件中Lorenz比为L_0/(1+4|ν_IQH|)，对孤立Majorana边界呈现反常；过剩散粒噪声随B变化（源于e/4涡旋隧穿）与锁定IQH平台形成对比。前提是量子Hall边缘不接触超导体。
AI.conclusion: 热导测量在反常数据相同时无法区分非阿贝尔拓扑与完全平衡的电子-空穴边缘模式，该局限是根本性的。区分机制必须来自电荷部门，因为其在超导边界处不被反常钉定；Lorenz比与散粒噪声可共同分辨机制。

title: Mapping Strain and Spatial-Modulation Phase from Local Wave Vectors in Scanning Tunneling Microscopy
summary: Spatially varying lattice distortions can produce local changes in electronic properties that are obscured by measurements averaging over extended regions. With its atomic-scale spatial resolution, scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) provides, in principle, a means of quantifying such distortions locally. A widely used approach for extracting local strain from STM images is the Lawler--Fujita (LF) algorithm [Lawler et al., Nature 466, 347 (2010)], which determines the displacement field from the phase of the lattice modulation and subsequently obtains the strain by differentiation. However, this approach requires two-dimensional phase unwrapping, which can fail in regions where the phase is ill-defined, particularly near topological defects such as edge dislocations. Here, we introduce an alternative approach that circumvents these limitations by directly measuring the local wave vector in real space. We derive the relationship between the local wave vector, strain, and the phase gradient, and show that the local wave vector mapping (LWM) algorithm remains robust even when the phase itself is ill-defined. This makes the method particularly well suited for imaging the phase-gradient textures associated with vortices and other topological defects. We benchmark the algorithm using simulated data containing known lattice distortions and artificially generated vortices. Finally, we apply the method to experimental STM data and resolve the charge density wave (CDW) incommensurabilities, lattice distortions, and CDW phase vortices in 4Ha-NbSe2 and 2H-NbSe2. The physical implications of these observations were recently reported by S. Sajan, X. Yang, et al. [arXiv:2607.20335 (2026)]. The program package and the example usage is publicly available at the GitHub: https://github.com/jsntxyang/LocalWavevectorMeasuremnt.

AI.tldr: 提出局部波矢映射(LWM)算法，无需二维相位解缠，可稳健提取STM图像的应变与相位梯度场。
AI.motivation: STM中常用的Lawler-Fujita(LF)算法依赖二维相位解缠，在相位定义不良区域(如边缘位错等拓扑缺陷附近)会失效。
AI.method: 直接在实空间测量局部波矢，推导局部波矢、应变与相位梯度间关系，实现LWM算法；用模拟数据(含已知晶格畸变与人工涡旋)进行基准测试。
AI.result: LWM在相位本身定义不良时仍保持稳健，适合成像涡旋及相关拓扑缺陷的相位梯度纹理；应用到4Ha-NbSe2与2H-NbSe2实验STM数据，解析出CDW非公度性、晶格畸变与CDW相位涡旋(物理意义见Sajan, Yang等arXiv:2607.20335)。
AI.conclusion: LWM规避了相位解缠限制，能在拓扑缺陷附近可靠提取局域应变与相位梯度，适用于CDW/涡旋研究；程序包已在GitHub公开。

title: Coupled quantum critical states in a circuit simulator
summary: Hybrid metal-semiconductor quantum circuits offer a controlled setting for realizing and probing strongly correlated quantum matter. A largely open question that may be addressed by such simulators is whether coupled critical states can combine into new non-Fermi liquid (NFL) phases. Inspired by the recent realization of a two-site charge-Kondo circuit [W. Pouse \textit{et al.}, \href{https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-022-01905-4}{Nat. Phys. \textbf{19}, 492 (2023)}], we uncover the fate of coupled Kondo anyons emerging from the two-channel-Kondo critical point at each site. Bosonization and quantum Brownian motion methods yield the full quasiballistic phase diagram and low-temperature transport properties, while numerical renormalization group calculations resolve the complementary weak-coupling limit. Together, these provide a unified description, and reveal robust NFL phases with continuously tunable transport and susceptibility exponents. Stronger inter-site coupling ultimately produces a screened Fermi liquid.

AI.tldr: 该文研究两站点电荷Kondo电路中从双通道Kondo临界点涌现的耦合Kondo任意子的命运，通过解析与数值方法给出完整相图，并发现具有连续可调输运和磁化率指数的稳健非费米液体相。
AI.motivation: 混合金属-半导体量子电路为探测强关联量子物质提供了可控平台，但耦合临界态能否组合成新的非费米液体（NFL）相仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 采用玻色化与量子布朗运动方法获得准弹道相图及低温输运性质，并用数值重整化群（NRG）计算解析弱耦合极限。
AI.result: 得到完整的准弹道相图与低温输运性质，揭示了具有连续可调输运和磁化率指数的稳健NFL相；更强的站点间耦合最终导致屏蔽的费米液体。
AI.conclusion: 耦合Kondo任意子可实现可调NFL相，为量子模拟强关联物质提供新途径。

title: General Time-Dependent Surface Flux for Multiple Ionization and Fragmentation of Molecules. I: General Theory
summary: We introduce a method for efficiently computing multiple photofragmentation of atoms and molecules into photoelectrons and nuclear fragments. The method is a generalization of the time-dependent surface flux originally introduced for single and double photoionization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效计算原子分子多光碎片化（多光电子与核碎片）的方法，是时间依赖表面通量（t-SURFF）方法向多重碎裂的推广。
AI.motivation: 原有时间依赖表面通量方法仅适用于单、双光电离，无法处理更一般的多重光碎片化问题，需要高效推广。
AI.method: 将时间依赖表面通量（t-SURFF）方法进行推广，用于处理原子和分子裂解为多个光电子与核碎片的场景。
AI.result: 实现了一种可高效计算多重光碎片化的方法（摘要未给出具体数值或验证结果）。
AI.conclusion: 该推广方法拓展了t-SURFF的适用范围，使其能高效处理多重光碎片化过程。

title: Exact Excitation Spectra and Spectral Gaps of the Frustrated Spin-1/2 $J_1$-$J_2$ Model via Dual Spin-Sector Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
summary: Finding excited states and excitation gaps in frustrated spin systems using Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQE) is complicated by state-ordering inversions. In the frustrated spin-1/2 $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model, standard single-sector algorithms like Variational Quantum Deflation (VQD) in $S_z=0$ fail when $J_2/J_1 < 0.25$. In this regime, the lowest-lying excitation in $S_z=0$ is a Triplet ($S=1$), which lies below the Excited Singlet ($S=0$). Standard deflation projects out the ground singlet and converges onto the Triplet state, misidentifying it as the Excited Singlet. Here, we present a Dual Spin-Sector VQE framework that resolves these state-ordering inversions across 1D spin chains and 2D rectangular lattices. By first optimizing the ground Triplet state in the $S_z=1$ sector (where singlet states cannot exist), mapping it into $S_z=0$ via the total spin-lowering operator $S^- = \sum_i S_i^-$, and evaluating a dual-sector penalty cost function, we isolate the Excited Singlet ($E_S$) without variational ambiguity. Numerical state-vector simulations confirm exact convergence to machine precision with unit overlap fidelity. The method captures key physical features, including the gapless phase, the BKT critical point at $J_2/J_1 \approx 0.2411$, the Majumdar-Ghosh dimer point ($J_2/J_1 = 0.50$), and the 2D non-magnetic frustrated regime ($J_2/J_1 \approx 0.40 - 0.60$). Finite-shot sampling simulations and gate-scaling analytics up to $N=100$ qubits demonstrate the resource efficiency and shot resilience of the algorithm for near-term quantum execution.

AI.tldr: 提出双自旋扇区VQE框架，解决阻挫自旋系统中态序反转问题，能精确分离激发单态。
AI.motivation: 阻挫自旋系统中，VQE/VQD等单扇区算法因态序反转而失效：在J2/J1<0.25时，Sz=0扇区最低激发是三态(S=1)而非激发单态，传统deflation会错误收敛到三态。
AI.method: 先在Sz=1扇区优化基态三态（单态无法存在），经总自旋降算符S-=ΣSi-映射到Sz=0，并用双扇区惩罚代价函数分离激发单态，消除变分歧义。
AI.result: 态矢量模拟达机器精度和单位重叠保真度；捕获无能隙相、BKT临界点(≈0.2411)、Majumdar-Ghosh二聚点(0.50)、2D非磁阻挫区(0.40-0.60)；有限采样与门数分析（至100量子比特）证明资源高效、抗采样噪声。
AI.conclusion: 双自旋扇区VQE可跨1D链和2D矩形晶格解决态序反转，适合近期量子硬件执行。

title: Charge transport in two-dimensional conductors with hybrid three-component plasma
summary: Electron--hole plasma in two-dimensional systems has mainly been studied in two limiting cases: degenerate semimetals with parabolic bands and nondegenerate symmetric Dirac systems such as graphene. Here we investigate a different regime realized in a gapless HgTe quantum well: a multicomponent plasma where massless Dirac carriers coexist with thermally activated heavy holes from lateral valence-band valleys. Near charge neutrality, the resistance increases approximately as $T^2$, in sharp contrast to the nearly temperature-independent resistivity expected for a symmetric Dirac plasma. We show that once heavy holes are populated, charge neutrality pins the chemical potential above the Dirac point, leaving the Dirac electrons moderately degenerate while the heavy holes remain nondegenerate and obey Boltzmann statistics. The light electrons therefore scatter almost elastically from the heavy holes, allowing a relaxation-time treatment of interparticle transport. Using carrier densities from self-consistent band-structure calculations, we reproduce the data with a short-range electron--hole interaction in the weakly disordered limit, for which the conductivity scales as $T^{-2}$ and the excess resistivity is proportional to the heavy-hole density. In contrast, an unscreened Coulomb interaction would give a temperature-independent conductivity. The extracted interaction amplitude is of the expected Coulomb scale. These results establish near-critical HgTe quantum wells as a platform for interaction-driven transport in multicomponent systems combining degenerate massless and nondegenerate massive carriers.

AI.tldr: 在HgTe量子阱中研究由无质量Dirac载流子与热激活重空穴共存的多组分电子-空穴等离子体，发现近电荷中性时电阻近似按T²增长，揭示了短程电子-空穴相互作用主导的输运机制。
AI.motivation: 二维电子-空穴等离子体此前主要研究两种极端情形：抛物线能带的简并半金属和石墨烯等非简并对称Dirac系统，而多组分Dirac与热激活重空穴共存的中间区域尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以gapless HgTe量子阱为平台，测量近电荷中性区电阻的温度依赖；结合自洽能带计算获得载流子密度，并用弛豫时间近似处理弹性散射的粒子间输运，分别考察短程与非屏蔽库仑电子-空穴相互作用。
AI.result: 近电荷中性时电阻随温度近似按T²增长，与对称Dirac等离子体几乎与温度无关的电阻率形成鲜明对比。电荷中性将化学势钉扎在Dirac点上方，使Dirac电子中等简并、重空穴保持非简并并服从Boltzmann统计。短程电子-空穴相互作用在弱无序极限下给出电导∝T⁻²、过剩电阻率正比于重空穴密度，可复现数据；非屏蔽库仑相互作用则给出与温度无关的电导。提取的相互作用幅度符合库仑尺度。
AI.conclusion: 近临界HgTe量子阱可作为研究简并无质量与非简并有质量载流子共存的多组分系统中相互作用驱动输运的平台。

title: Landau Theory for Non-relativistic Magnetism Beyond Altermagnetism
summary: In this work we study phenomenological Landau theories of non-relativistic magnetic systems, generalizing work on the collinear case to coplanar and non-coplanar orders. Focusing on zero-wavevector ($\boldsymbol{k}=0$) magnetic orders described by a single irreducible representation of the crystallographic point group, we construct the symmetry-allowed free energies to quartic order for all possible multi-dimensional irreducible ordering channels. We find distinct Landau theories for tetragonal, trigonal/hexagonal, and cubic symmetry. Similar to the case of spin-nematic fluids, we find two natural outcomes: a collapse to a lower-symmetry collinear phase or a genuinely coplanar or non-coplanar order where the order parameters form a mutually orthogonal set in spin space -- reminiscent of the $A$ and $B$ phases in ${}^3$He. We show in general that this symmetry-broken phase realizes the spin space group associated with the spatial representation of the order parameter sharing the same parent space group as the paramagnetic phase. This provides a direct link between the Landau and spin space group approaches. We calculate key observables using this Landau approach, including net magnetization, spin conductivity, multipolar moments, and piezomagnetism, connecting our results to constraints from the underlying spin space group. Examples of coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic orders for each case are worked out in detail. Finally, we discuss the relationship of the lower-symmetry collinear phases to the usual collinear spin groups, as well as connections to atomic altermagnetism, superfluid ${}^3$He and electronic nematic phases.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究非相对论磁性系统的唯象朗道理论，将共线情形推广到共面与非共面磁序，建立了朗道方法与自旋空间群方法之间的直接联系。
AI.motivation: 以往朗道理论工作多集中于共线磁序，对共面和非共面磁序（尤其在k=0、单一不可约表示描述的情形）缺乏系统刻画，且朗道方法与自旋空间群方法之间缺乏明确联系。
AI.method: 针对由晶体点群单一不可约表示描述的k=0磁序，构造所有可能多维不可约序参量通道到四阶的对称性允许自由能；分析四方、三方/六方和立方对称性下的不同朗道理论，并计算净磁化、自旋电导、多极矩和压磁等可观测量。
AI.result: 发现两种典型结果：坍缩为低对称共线相，或形成自旋空间中相互正交的共面/非共面序（类似³He的A、B相）。证明该对称破缺相实现与序参量空间表示相关联的自旋空间群，且与顺磁相共享母空间群，从而直接连接朗道与自旋空间群方法；并给出各情形下具体例子。
AI.conclusion: 朗道理论可系统刻画共面/非共面k=0磁序，并与自旋空间群、共线自旋群、原子交替磁性、超流³He及电子向列相建立联系，为理解复杂磁序提供了统一框架。

title: Screening of tensor properties by magnetic point group symmetries: The PythMPG code package
summary: Understanding the symmetry requirements that permit specific phenomena or physical effects is crucial in condensed matter physics for identifying candidate materials that exhibit one or more of these effects. To this end, screening tensor properties based on (magnetic) point-group symmetries is of particular interest. Here, we present the PythMPG code package, a tool designed for this purpose. Inspired by the MTENSOR utility of the Bilbao Crystallographic Server, PythMPG performs symmetry analysis in a self-contained way to determine which tensors, characterized by their Jahn symbols, are allowed for each magnetic point group and how many symmetry-allowed independent components each tensor possesses. We describe the structure of the code and present some illustrative examples.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 PythMPG 代码包，用于基于（磁）点群对称性筛选张量性质，判断各磁点群允许哪些 Jahn 符号张量及其独立分量数量，并给出代码结构与示例。
AI.motivation: 在凝聚态物理中，理解允许特定现象或物理效应的对称性要求，对于识别能表现出这些效应的候选材料至关重要。因此，基于（磁）点群对称性来筛选张量性质具有特别的意义。
AI.method: 受 Bilbao 晶体学服务器 MTENSOR 工具启发，开发了自包含的 PythMPG 代码包。该工具通过对称性分析，确定每个磁点群允许哪些由 Jahn 符号表征的张量，以及每个张量具有多少个对称性允许的独立分量。文中描述了代码结构并给出示例。
AI.result: PythMPG 能够对全部磁点群完成张量允许性判断，输出每个张量的 Jahn 符号及其独立分量数目，并通过若干示例展示其功能。
AI.conclusion: PythMPG 为基于磁点群对称性筛选张量性质提供了一个自包含、实用的工具，有助于识别表现特定物理效应的候选材料。

title: Gentle Floquet control of orbital Hall effect and orbital inverse Faraday effect
summary: Floquet engineering controls material responses via a time-periodic electromagnetic drive. An important task in practise is to reduce the driving strengths required to implement Floquet protocols.We show that in systems with strong phase-space constraints, where the response is dominated by a small region of momentum space, the relative impact of a resonant Floquet drive is enhanced. We demonstrate this idea on the example of the orbital Hall effect, where equilibrium occupations restrict the interband coherence to a narrow momentum interval $\hbarΔk$. The ratio $eE_0/(Ω_0\hbarΔk)$, where $Ω_0$ is the frequency of the drive, is considerable even at modest field amplitudes $E_0$, leading to a large relative change in the orbital Hall conductivity. Due to the non-trivial orbital texture, the circularly polarized drive induces an inverse orbital Faraday effect by magnetizing the electrons. We show that the corresponding susceptibility is controlled by the interband quantum metric that determines the resonant Floquet hybridization.

AI.tldr: 在存在强相空间约束的系统中，共振Floquet驱动的相对影响被放大，因而可在较小驱动强度下显著改变轨道霍尔电导率，并诱导出由带间量子度规控制的逆轨道法拉第效应。
AI.motivation: 实际应用Floquet工程的关键难题在于所需驱动强度往往过大，因此需要寻找降低驱动强度要求、增强Floquet协议实现效率的机制。
AI.method: 作者提出并利用强相空间约束这一思路：当系统响应主要由动量空间中一小块区域主导时，共振Floquet驱动的相对影响会被增强。以轨道霍尔效应为例，平衡占据将带间相干限制在窄动量区间ħΔk内，并用比值 eE₀/(Ω₀ħΔk) 刻画驱动强度、驱动频率与动量窗口之间的关系。
AI.result: 即便在适中的场幅E₀下，该比值也可观，从而引起轨道霍尔电导率的显著相对变化；同时，由于非平庸的轨道织构，圆偏振驱动通过磁化电子诱导出逆轨道法拉第效应，其响应率由决定共振Floquet杂化的带间量子度规控制。
AI.conclusion: 强相空间约束为降低Floquet驱动强度提供了一条可行途径，并揭示了轨道霍尔体系中由量子度规主导的逆轨道法拉第效应等新响应。

title: Solphin: Photovoltaic efficiency analysis for bulk materials using Python
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, for the associated code, see https://github.com/SMTG-Bham/solphin
summary: In the development of photovoltaic materials, computational simulation has become a important tool for reducing the time and cost of exploring novel materials, as well as providing insights that help drive improvements in efficiency through increasing fundamental understanding. We present Solphin, a Python package for the generation, post-processing and analysis of photovoltaic calculations from periodic solid state Density Functional Theory. We include the ability to calculate the photovoltaic Figure of Merit, detailed balance and spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency, alongside other analysis methods. Solphin has been built to improve the access, reproducibility and ease of evaluating the photovoltaic potential of a material in an efficient and user-friendly manner.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为Solphin的Python软件包，用于基于周期性固态DFT计算生成、后处理和分析光伏计算，包括光伏品质因数、细致平衡和SLME分析，旨在提升材料光伏潜力评估的可及性、可重复性和便捷性。
AI.motivation: 光伏材料开发中，计算模拟可降低探索新材料的时间与成本，并加深基础理解以推动效率提升。但现有评估光伏潜力的流程在可及性、可重复性和易用性上仍存在不足，需要统一高效的工具。
AI.method: 开发了Python软件包Solphin，针对周期性固态密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，提供光伏计算的生成、后处理与分析功能；内置光伏品质因数（Figure of Merit）、细致平衡（detailed balance）和光谱极限最大效率（SLME）等分析方法。
AI.result: Solphin集成了多种光伏分析能力，能够高效、用户友好地评估材料的光伏潜力。
AI.conclusion: Solphin为光伏材料的光伏潜力评估提供了可及、可重复且易用的计算工具，有助于加速新材料探索。

title: Beyond Equilibrium Raman Thermometry: Fermi-Level Control of the Anti-Stokes Response in Graphene
comment: Main text: 24 pages, 5 figures Supporting Information: 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: Non-equilibrium electron and phonon populations govern heat generation and dissipation in nanoscale devices, yet their direct characterization remains challenging. Anti-Stokes Raman scattering provides a sensitive probe of phonon populations and local temperatures, although its interpretation becomes more complex when electronic and phononic populations are driven out of equilibrium. Here, we investigate the gate-dependent anti-Stokes Raman response of monolayer graphene and find that the anti-Stokes response deviates from that expected from an equilibrium phonon population. Using a spatially localized microdroplet spectroelectrochemical platform, dielectric back-gates, and chemical doping, we observe a strong and reversible suppression of the G-mode anti-Stokes intensity as the Fermi level is tuned away from the Dirac point, while the Stokes intensity remains essentially unchanged. By contrast, the G-mode frequency and linewidth of both the Stokes and anti-Stokes branches evolve with doping as expected from the established Kohn-anomaly picture. The anti-Stokes/Stokes intensity ratio decreases by several-fold over the measured range and displays a pronounced, gate-dependent power response with maximum sensitivity at charge neutrality. Comparison with previous studies of non-equilibrium carrier dynamics in doped graphene suggests an important role of Fermi-level-dependent electronic phase space, which can influence both hot-carrier-driven phonon populations and electronically mediated Stokes-anti-Stokes scattering. Our findings establish anti-Stokes Raman scattering as a sensitive probe of electron-phonon coupling and non-equilibrium phonon dynamics in graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单层石墨烯栅极依赖的反斯托克斯拉曼响应，发现其偏离平衡声子分布，建立了探测电子-声子耦合与非平衡声子动力学的方法。
AI.motivation: 非平衡电子与声子布居决定纳米器件的产热与耗散，但直接表征困难；反斯托克斯拉曼散射虽敏感，却在电子与声子布居非平衡时解释复杂。
AI.method: 采用空间局域微滴光谱电化学平台、介电背栅与化学掺杂，测量单层石墨烯栅极依赖的反斯托克斯拉曼响应。
AI.result: 费米能级远离狄拉克点时G模反斯托克斯强度被强烈可逆抑制，斯托克斯强度基本不变；S/AS强度比下降数倍，呈栅极依赖的功率响应，在电荷中性点灵敏度最高；频移与线宽变化符合Kohn反常图像。
AI.conclusion: 费米能级依赖的电子相空间起重要作用，影响热载流子驱动的声子布居与电子介导的斯托克斯-反斯托克斯散射；反斯托克斯拉曼散射可作为探测石墨烯电子-声子耦合与非平衡声子动力学的灵敏探针。

title: Universal orbital-coupling rules for hydrogen-defect interactions in bcc metals
summary: Hydrogen-defect interactions control the performance of body-centered-cubic (bcc) metals. However, the complex variations among defects lead to various empirical models that lack transferability across defects. Here, we propose an orbital-coupling model, built on coordination number and interatomic distance, that quantifies the H solution energetics across nanovoids, vacancy loops and grain boundaries in bcc metals, and even predicts the potential-energy surfaces of H at nanovoids. Our model reveals an unconventional s-d coupling rule in the confined environment of defects: H-metal interactions exhibit a unique coordination-dependent law, whereas H-H interactions, deviating from the usually speculated s-s coupling, acquire the distance-decay law of H-metal coupling. This unusual rule proves essential to reproduce the experimentally observed bimodal profile of H desorption. Our electronic-structure-origin, unified model is thus crucial to understanding the nature of chemical bonds under constraint and engineering the H-tolerant materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于配位数与原子间距的轨道耦合模型，统一描述bcc金属中H与纳米空洞、空位环、晶界的相互作用能学，并揭示缺陷约束下非常规的s-d耦合规律。
AI.motivation: 氢-缺陷相互作用决定bcc金属性能，但缺陷类型复杂多变，现有经验模型缺乏跨缺陷的可迁移性，亟需统一且具电子结构根源的理论模型。
AI.method: 构建以配位数和原子间距为变量的轨道耦合模型，量化H在纳米空洞、空位环与晶界中的溶解能学，并预测H在纳米空洞处的势能面。
AI.result: 模型揭示非常规s-d耦合规则：H-金属相互作用遵循独特的配位依赖律，而H-H相互作用偏离通常设想的s-s耦合，呈现类似H-金属耦合的距离衰减律；该规则成功再现实验观测的H脱附双峰分布。
AI.conclusion: 该具电子结构根源的统一模型有助于理解受限条件下化学键本质，并指导抗氢（耐氢）材料的设计与工程。

title: Quantum-vortex excitons beyond band topology
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, plus Supplementary Information (35 pages, 15 figures)
summary: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. Here, we explain how Coulomb phase matching stabilises a quantum-vortex exciton as the lowest bound state in flat Chern bands. Using a prototypical Yin--Yang kagome lattice, we demonstrate that increasing the spin--orbit coupling drives a transition of the lowest exciton from a quantum-vortex state to a zero-winding state, while leaving the band Chern numbers unchanged. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. By comparing states with identical wavefunction amplitudes, we isolate this phase contribution and show that it is sufficient to drive the reversal in exciton ordering. We classify exciton topology by the momentum-space wavefunction winding relative to the conduction--valence Chern-number difference,connecting the competing states to circular-polarisation selection rules. We then show that the resulting reordering can be tracked directly in the optical absorption spectrum, through the transition from a dark vortex exciton to a bright zero-winding exciton. These findings establish a microscopic link between exciton topology, Coulomb binding, and optical response that extends beyond the information contained in the underlying electronic band Chern numbers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了平坦Chern带中激子的拓扑性质，发现库仑相位匹配可稳定量子涡旋激子作为最低束缚态，并揭示了自旋轨道耦合驱动的涡旋态到零缠绕态的转变。
AI.motivation: 典型低维半导体的最低激子是无节点s型。作者想探究在平坦Chern带这一特殊环境下，激子基态是否会被拓扑性质改变，以及激子拓扑与电子能带Chern数之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用典型的Yin-Yang kagome晶格模型，通过调控自旋轨道耦合强度，并借助规范不变的激子相位差与Bloch重叠相位组合，对比波函数振幅相同但相位不同的态，分离出相位贡献。
AI.result: 增大自旋轨道耦合会使最低激子从量子涡旋态转变为零缠绕态，而能带Chern数保持不变；该相变由相位贡献单独驱动。激子拓扑可由动量空间波函数缠绕数相对导带-价带Chern数差来分类，并对应圆偏振选择定则。该重排表现为从暗涡旋激子到亮零缠绕激子的光学吸收转变。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了激子拓扑、库仑束缚与光学响应之间的微观联系，表明激子性质超出了电子能带Chern数所包含的信息。

title: Surface Physics of Low-Dimensional Pnictogen Chalcohalides and Its Impact on Photovoltaic Technologies
summary: Low-dimensional pnictogen chalcohalides (MChX; M = Bi, Sb; Ch = S, Se; X = I, Br) are promising non-toxic semiconductors for solar energy conversion, yet the power conversion efficiencies of MChX solar cells remain below 10%, far from their Shockley-Queisser limit of $\sim$30%. Efficient charge extraction depends critically on the band-edge alignment between the absorber and the charge-selective contacts, which is a surface property. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with device-level modelling to investigate the surface energetics and band alignments across the MChX family. An exhaustive sampling of crystal orientations, including low-symmetry facets, identifies the (011) and (010) surfaces as the most stable terminations in all eight compounds. Their formation energies differ by only $\approx 0.01$-$0.03\mathrm{J\,m^{-2}}$, yet their band edges are shifted rigidly with respect to each other by up to $0.8$eV. Drift-diffusion simulations of BiSBr show that the coexistence of such facets can reduce the open-circuit voltage by up to $0.6$V, even in an otherwise ideal, defect-free absorber. Surface orientation thus emerges as a hidden design parameter for charge extraction. This study may help to explain the gap between the theoretical and experimental efficiencies of MChX solar cells, and it provides new design principles for MChX-based photovoltaic and photocatalytic technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算与器件建模，研究了MChX家族（Bi/Sb + S/Se + I/Br）表面能与能带对齐，发现稳定晶面共存会显著降低开路电压。
AI.motivation: MChX是无毒半导体太阳能材料，但效率远低于理论极限，原因可能与吸收层与选择性接触间的能带对齐（表面性质）有关。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算与器件级漂移-扩散模拟，系统采样晶体取向（含低对称晶面），分析八种化合物的表面能与能带对齐。
AI.result: (011)和(010)面为最稳定终止面，形成能仅差约0.01–0.03 J/m²，但能带边缘相对刚性偏移可达0.8 eV；BiSBr模拟显示晶面共存可使开路电压降低多达0.6 V。
AI.conclusion: 表面取向是电荷提取的隐藏设计参数，可解释MChX电池理论与实验效率差距，并为光伏与光催化技术提供新设计原则。

title: Deterministic Vortex Generation from Coupled Trapped Polariton Condensate Triad
summary: We present the deterministic generation and all-optical switching of ternary topologically distinct vortex states in a triad of trapped exciton-polariton condensates with direct state readout from momentum-space emission distribution. Tuning the non-resonant pump power controls the sign of the dissipative coupling, selecting between a ferromagnetic in-phase state and two frustrated states with global phase winding. The zero-winding ferromagnetic state has unstructured far-field emission at low momenta and forms vortex-antivortex arrays at the Dirac points, reflecting the C_3v global symmetry. The two frustrated states of +-2pi winding can be activated on-demand by a control beam and produce different triangular emission patterns selectively localized at the K or K' points. Although all three states share identical real-space emission distributions, their momentum-space photoluminescence profiles distinguish them unambiguously, revealing the chirality without the need for interferometry. This enables on-demand orbital angular momentum control using a pump independent of resonant phase or OAM imprinting, establishing condensate triads as a compact platform for reconfigurable chiral light generation operating on a ternary logic basis.

AI.tldr: 在三个耦合的激子-极化激元凝聚体（triad）中实现了三种拓扑上不同的涡旋态的确定性生成与全光开关，并可从动量空间发光直接读出状态，无需干涉测量。
AI.motivation: 需要一种紧凑、可重构且无需谐振相位或OAM印记即可控制轨道角动量（手性）的平台，并支持三值逻辑操作。
AI.method: 利用三个直接耦合的俘获激子-极化激元凝聚体构成triad，通过调节非谐振泵浦功率控制耗散耦合的符号，从而在铁磁同相态与两个带全局相位绕数的受阻态之间切换；用控制光束按需激活 ±2π 绕数态。
AI.result: 铁磁零绕数态在低动量处远场发光无结构，并在狄拉克点形成涡旋-反涡旋阵列，反映 C3v 对称性；两个受阻态分别选择性地在 K 或 K' 点产生不同的三角形发光图案。三种态在实空间发光分布相同，但动量空间光致发光谱可明确区分，无需干涉测量即可揭示手性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了基于泵浦的按需轨道角动量控制，证明凝聚体triad可作为可重构手性光生成的紧凑平台，并以三值逻辑为基础运行。

title: Lattice dynamics of disordered phases of silicon and spatially resolved computations of thermal conductivity
summary: The lattice dynamics of disordered systems (amorphous solids, polymers and glasses) are often distinct from crystalline analogues. Examples include the "two-level systems" and the Boson peak. Here, we show that even the venerable material amorphous silicon offers new wrinkles: (1) realistic networks studied with DFT-quality interatomic potentials show the existence of harmonic modes exhibiting anomalously large root-mean-square variation in atomic positions, and (2) these dynamics determine the processes of heat transport. We correlate the atomic dynamics with transport using the site-projected thermal conductivity [C. Ugwumadu et. al Phys. Status Solidi B 263, e202500316 (2026)], and conjecture that these observations are relevant to other disordered systems.

AI.tldr: 非晶硅中即使采用DFT级势函数，仍存在异常大的原子位移涨落的简谐模式，且这些模式主导热输运。
AI.motivation: 无序体系（非晶固体、聚合物、玻璃）的晶格动力学常与晶体不同，如"二能级系统"和玻色峰。作者希望重新审视经典的非晶硅，探索其中是否还有未被发现的动力学新特征，并理解其对热输运的影响。
AI.method: 采用DFT级精度的原子间势构建真实非晶硅网络，计算其简谐振动模式，分析原子位置的均方根涨落，并结合位点投影热导率将原子动力学与热输运关联起来。
AI.result: 发现非晶硅中存在均方根原子位置涨落异常大的简谐模式；这些动力学模式决定了热输运过程，并可通过位点投影热导率建立关联。
AI.conclusion: 非晶硅展现出新的动力学特征，其简谐模式决定热输运，作者推测这一现象可能适用于其他无序体系。

title: Exciton switching and tunable exciton-phonon coupling in Oxygen doped ZnO nanorods
summary: Self ion doping in ZnO nanorods offers a powerful route to dynamically control excitonic states and light matter interactions. Here, vertically aligned hexagonal ZnO nanorods were irradiated with 250 keV oxygen ions to establish a direct link between irradiation induced defects and excitonic and optical responses. Increasing ion fluence progressively quenches the near band edge emission at 380 nm, leading to a complete exciton OFF state, while thermal annealing restores the emission, yielding a reversible exciton OFF or ON response. This switching originates from defect mediated modification and thermal recovery of excitonic states. The defect band emission, between 400 to 750 nm, exhibits quasi periodic whispering gallery mode like resonances that are progressively suppressed as irradiation alters nanorod geometry and optical confinement. Low-temperature photoluminescence resolves D0X, FX 1LO, and FX 2LO transitions, whose temperature evolution follows the Bose Einstein model. The non-monotonic variation of excition phonon coupling strength reveals a competition among irradiation induced defects, lattice distortion, and exciton localization in determining exciton phonon coupling. These results establish Oxygen ion irradiation as a means to simultaneously engineer excitonic switching, exciton phonon interactions, and optical resonances, providing a pathway toward defect programmable ZnO nanophotonic and optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 通过250 keV氧离子辐照ZnO纳米棒，实现激子开/关切换、缺陷带共振抑制及激子-声子耦合调控，并可热退火恢复。
AI.motivation: 探索一种动态调控ZnO纳米棒激子态与光-物质相互作用的途径，并建立辐照缺陷与激子/光学响应之间的直接关联。
AI.method: 对垂直排列的六方ZnO纳米棒进行250 keV氧离子辐照，结合不同注量、热退火、变温光致发光（含D0X、FX-1LO、FX-2LO）与缺陷带发光（400–750 nm）分析。
AI.result: 随注量增加，380 nm近带边发射逐渐淬灭至完全"激子OFF"；退火可恢复，形成可逆OFF/ON切换。缺陷带呈现准周期回音壁模式共振并随辐照抑制。变温发光服从Bose-Einstein模型，激子-声子耦合强度非单调变化，反映缺陷、晶格畸变与激子局域化之间的竞争。
AI.conclusion: 氧离子辐照可同时调控激子切换、激子-声子相互作用与光学共振，为缺陷可编程的ZnO纳米光子与光电器件提供途径。

title: Prediction of the thermal neutron response of grain-boundary impedance in Gd-doped ceria based on the radiation-ionic effect
summary: The radiation-ionic effect was reported in 3 mol% Gd-doped CeO$_2$ (3GDC): under $^{60}$Co gamma irradiation at 35 Gy/min, the grain-boundary (GB) ionic resistance of a bulk pellet decreased 680-fold at room temperature because radiation-generated electrons trapped at the GB core lower the space-charge potential. The effect has only been demonstrated with photons. Here the response of 3GDC to thermal neutrons is predicted. Neutrons are absorbed by $^{157}$Gd (254 kb); about 50 keV per capture is deposited within 1 $μ$m by conversion and Auger electrons, and Gd segregates to the GBs, so the energy is delivered to the interfaces that block ionic transport. This source term is expressed as a GB-effective generation rate and used in the Mott-Schottky/Seager framework calibrated on the published gamma data. The gamma temperature series fixes the temperature dependence of the single trap parameter (about 1.1 eV), and this calibration reproduces the trap parameter obtained from independent thin-film UV data at 400 $^\circ$C. A thermal flux of $6\times10^{9}$ cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$ gives the same GB-effective generation rate as the 35 Gy/min calibration. At room temperature the predicted GB resistance ratio is about 150 (90% interval 100-290) at $10^{9}$ and about 1300 (900-2500) at $10^{10}$ cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$; the response vanishes above 60 $^\circ$C at $10^{9}$ and 80 $^\circ$C at $10^{10}$. Because capture events are discrete, the continuous-source description holds only if the trapped charge of one event outlasts the next; this is met at $10^{10}$ and marginal at $10^{9}$, so the recovery time constant is the first quantity a neutron experiment should measure. Self-shielding is partly offset by Compton absorption of the capture photons; above 5 mol% Gd the response is limited by the weak dark barrier. Source parameters, sample geometry and controls needed to test the prediction are given.

AI.tldr: 预测3GDC块体对热中子的辐射-离子响应，通过伽马数据校准框架估算晶界电阻降低幅度约150-1300倍。
AI.motivation: 辐射-离子效应此前仅用光子（伽马）证实，尚不清楚对热中子的响应，因此需要预测3GDC在热中子辐照下的行为。
AI.method: 利用^157Gd高热中子吸收截面（254 kb）和晶界偏聚，将俘获能量沉积表述为晶界有效产生率；在Mott-Schottky/Seager框架中，用已发表伽马数据（含温度序列，陷阱参数约1.1 eV）校准，并以独立薄膜UV数据验证。
AI.result: 热通量6×10^9 cm^-2s^-1对应与35 Gy/min相同的晶界有效产生率。室温晶界电阻比：10^9约150（90%区间100-290），10^10约1300（900-2500）；10^9在60°C以上、10^10在80°C以上响应消失。10^10连续源描述成立，10^9仅为临界。
AI.conclusion: 中子实验首先应测恢复时间常数；自屏蔽被俘获光子的康普顿吸收部分抵消，Gd超过5 mol%时响应受弱暗势垒限制；文中给出测试预测所需的源参数、样品几何和控制条件。

title: Pseudospin Hall Transport Induced by Berry Curvature
summary: Pseudospin-1 Dirac systems exhibit unique physics distinct from conventional Dirac cones, such as flat-band crossings and non-Abelian characteristics, yet their topological transport properties have remained largely untapped in passive, time-reversal-invariant settings. Here we uncover an in-plane polarity of the Berry-curvature texture in a pseudospin-1 Dirac Hamiltonian, a previously unexplored geometric degree of freedom encoded in the sign-resolved distribution of Berry curvature despite zero net Berry flux, and reveal a new mechanics where Berry curvature induce pseudospin Hall behaviors in a system. We show that the oriented coupling between this momentum-space polarity and a real-space mass gradient governs a geometric selection rule that dictates the emergence of gapless pseudospin Hall modes. By engineering the intracell couplings of a four-site planar lattice, we independently program the Berry-curvature polarity and the spatial mass gradient without altering the host lattice symmetry. Acoustic experiments directly confirm this directional selection rule: reversing the mass gradient closes or reopens the dispersive gap, while pseudospin-selective source excitation launches counterpropagating pseudospin branches along arbitrary prescribed axes. Our work establishes quantum geometric polarity as a versatile tool for reconfigurable wave routing, sensing, and high-capacity quantum applications.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示赝自旋-1狄拉克系统中Berry曲率织构的面内极性，发现其与实空间质量梯度耦合的几何选择规则，实现可控无隙赝自旋霍尔模式。
AI.motivation: 赝自旋-1狄拉克系统具有平带交叉等独特物理，但其在被动、时间反演不变体系中的拓扑输运性质尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建赝自旋-1狄拉克哈密顿量，识别Berry曲率符号分辨分布中的面内极性（净Berry通量为零）；通过设计四格点平面晶格的胞内耦合，独立编程Berry曲率极性与空间质量梯度而不改变晶格对称性；开展声学实验验证。
AI.result: 声学实验直接证实方向选择规则：反转质量梯度可关闭或重开色散能隙；赝自旋选择性源激发沿任意指定轴发射反向传播的赝自旋分支。
AI.conclusion: 量子几何极性成为可重构波路由、传感及高容量量子应用的通用工具。

title: Magnetic Order from First-Principles Linear Response
summary: The magnetic order of a material is usually predicted by comparing the energies of trial spin configurations, a strategy that cannot reach orders outside the chosen set and rapidly becomes intractable as the number of magnetic sites grows. We show that the order can instead be identified directly from the paramagnetic state: the leading eigenmodes of its self-consistent magnetization response, obtained with spin--orbit coupling at arbitrary wavevector within the primitive cell, determine both the ordering wavevector and the pattern of moments, with no candidate configurations. With no prior assumption about the order, the method correctly reproduces the G-type stacking with out-of-plane moments in the altermagnet candidate KV$_2$Se$_2$O, the $3{:}1$ ferrimagnetic tetrahedra of Cu$_2$OSeO$_3$, and the incommensurate spiral instability of monolayer NiI$_2$. Our results establish the response of the paramagnetic state as a predictive and unbiased route to assessing magnetic order, enabling systematic searches for complex magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从顺磁态的自洽磁化响应本征模直接确定磁有序，无需预设候选自旋构型，能同时给出序波矢和磁矩模式。
AI.motivation: 传统方法通过比较试验自旋构型的能量来预测磁序，无法覆盖候选集之外的序，且随磁性位点增多迅速变得不可行，亟需一种无需候选构型的无偏方法。
AI.method: 在考虑自旋-轨道耦合下，计算顺磁态自洽磁化响应在原胞内任意波矢处的主导本征模，由其直接确定有序波矢与磁矩模式，无需任何关于磁序的先验假设。
AI.result: 该方法正确重现了altermagnet候选材料KV₂Se₂O的G型堆叠及面外磁矩、Cu₂OSeO₃的3:1亚铁磁四面体，以及单层NiI₂的非公度螺旋不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 顺磁态的响应可作为预测且无偏的磁序评估途径，支持复杂磁体的系统性搜索。

title: Electronic Structure Descriptors for CO$_2$ Conversion Activity in Perovskite Oxides
summary: Electronic structure descriptors have been widely used to rationalize catalytic activity, but their application to CO$_2$-to-CH$_4$ conversion in perovskite oxides remains relatively limited. Here, we investigate six electronic structure descriptors related to band centers and bandwidths. We find that the unoccupied transition-metal (TM) $3d$-band center, charge-transfer energy, and the ratio of the unoccupied TM $3d$ to occupied O $2p$ bandwidths, $W_{3d}/W_{2p}$, exhibit negative correlations with CH$_4$ activity. These qualitative trends are further quantified using a parametric brute-force searching (BFS) approach to obtain explicit fitting equations. Notably, the selected equations depend only on $W_{3d}/W_{2p}$, providing an electronic structure perspective on the enhanced activity in double perovskites. We apply the selected equation to screen 24 La-based double perovskites. This screening suggests that La$_2$CoGaO$_6$, La$_2$CoAlO$_6$, and Ti-containing compositions are promising candidates. The present approach can help identify descriptor-activity relationships and guide materials screening in perovskite oxides.

AI.tldr: 研究六种电子结构描述符与钙钛矿氧化物CO2-to-CH4活性的关系，发现未占据TM 3d带中心、电荷转移能及W3d/W2p与CH4活性负相关，并通过BFS拟合得到仅依赖W3d/W2p的方程，用于筛选24种La基双钙钛矿，推荐La2CoGaO6、La2CoAlO6及含Ti组分。
AI.motivation: 电子结构描述符广泛用于解释催化活性，但在钙钛矿氧化物CO2-to-CH4转化中的应用仍有限，需要建立描述符-活性关系以指导材料筛选。
AI.method: 考察六种与带中心和带宽相关的电子结构描述符；用参数化暴力搜索（BFS）将定性趋势量化为显式拟合方程；将所选方程应用于24种La基双钙钛矿的筛选。
AI.result: 未占据TM 3d带中心、电荷转移能和W3d/W2p与CH4活性呈负相关；所选拟合方程仅依赖W3d/W2p，为双钙钛矿活性增强提供电子结构解释；筛选出La2CoGaO6、La2CoAlO6及含Ti组分为有前景候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 该描述符-活性分析方法有助于识别钙钛矿氧化物中的描述符-活性关系并指导材料筛选。

title: Interface Doping Mechanism of p-Type Conductivity in Mist-CVD-Grown LiGa5O8 Thin Films
summary: LiGa5O8 is an ultrawide-bandgap oxide semiconductor that has recently been experimentally demonstrated to exhibit p-type conductivity; however, the origin of the observed p-type transport remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the origin of p-type conductivity by systematically comparing the electrical, compositional, and structural properties of mist chemical vapor deposition (mist-CVD) grown LiGa5O8 thin films exhibiting either p-type conductivity or insulating behavior under different growth conditions. The p-conductive films exhibit room-temperature hole concentrations on the order of 10^18 cm^-3. The emergence of p-type conductivity is found to be strongly correlated with the elemental composition of the films, with X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) revealing a reduced Li/Ga ratio in the p-conductive films, indicative of a Li-deficient composition. Raman spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction (XRD) further reveal signatures of \b{eta}-Ga2O3 in the p-conductive films that are absent in the insulating films, demonstrating the formation of a secondary \b{eta}-Ga2O3 phase. Considering the reported type-II band alignment between LiGa5O8 and \b{eta}-Ga2O3, together with theoretically predicted acceptor levels associated Li vacancies (V_Li) in LiGa5O8, the formation of mixed LiGa5O8/\b{eta}-Ga2O3 phases is proposed to facilitate electron transfer from the \b{eta}-Ga2O3 valence band to acceptor states in LiGa5O8, thereby promoting hole accumulation and p-type conductivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对比mist-CVD生长的p型导电与绝缘LiGa5O8薄膜，揭示p型导电源于Li缺陷成分及β-Ga2O3第二相的形成。
AI.motivation: LiGa5O8作为超宽禁带氧化物半导体已被实验证实具有p型导电性，但其p型传输的起源尚不清楚，需要系统研究其微观机制。
AI.method: 采用mist-CVD生长不同条件下的LiGa5O8薄膜，系统对比其电学、成分和结构性质，结合XPS、Raman光谱、XRD分析，并基于II型能带对齐及V_Li受主能级的理论预测进行机理推断。
AI.result: p型导电薄膜室温空穴浓度约10^18 cm^-3；XPS显示p型薄膜Li/Ga比降低（Li缺陷）；Raman和XRD发现p型薄膜中存在绝缘薄膜所没有的β-Ga2O3第二相特征。
AI.conclusion: LiGa5O8/β-Ga2O3混合相的形成促进电子从β-Ga2O3价带转移至LiGa5O8受主态，从而增强空穴积累并导致p型导电。
